local ridgeVisuals:{[Instance]:{BasePart}}={}
local function reclaimRidgeForCastle(arena:Instance):boolean
 local bucket=ridgeVisuals[arena]
 if not bucket then return false end
 while #bucket>0 do
  local p=table.remove(bucket)
  if p and p.Parent then
   p:Destroy()
   budgets[arena]=math.max(0,(budgets[arena] or 0)-1)
   return true
  end
 end
 return false
end
-- GQ470_FORTRESS_VISUAL_FAIR_BUDGET_REAL69_20261121
-- Reserve ten existing identity parts per castle, without increasing the
-- existing per-arena 320-Part limit or 19-Part optional castle detail limit.
local MIN_CASTLE_ESSENTIAL_PARTS = 10
-- Keep only this art author's instances; do not count gameplay geometry.
-- Old castles/other art can be removed during a match: prune stale references
-- before every new castle, so the counter never prevents later roofs/crests.
local trackedArt:{[Instance]:{BasePart}}={}
local function recountArenaArt(arena:Instance):{BasePart}
 local active:{BasePart}={}
 for _,p in ipairs(trackedArt[arena] or {}) do
  if p.Parent and p:IsDescendantOf(arena) then table.insert(active,p) end
 end
 trackedArt[arena]=active
 budgets[arena]=#active
 return active
end
local function reserveCastleIdentity(arena:Instance):boolean
 local active=recountArenaArt(arena)
 while #active+MIN_CASTLE_ESSENTIAL_PARTS>MAX_VISUAL_PARTS_PER_ARENA do
  -- Reclaim only expendable decorations, NEVER a roof/keystone/crest.
  local optionalIndex:number?=nil
  for index=#active,1,-1 do
   if active[index]:GetAttribute("GQ470CastleOptional")==true then
    optionalIndex=index
    break
   end
  end
  if not optionalIndex then return false end
  local old=table.remove(active,optionalIndex)
  if old then old:Destroy() end
  budgets[arena]=#active
 end
 return true
end

if (budgets[arena] or 0)>=MAX_VISUAL_PARTS_PER_ARENA then
  if parent.Name~="EGGRUMBLE_CastleArt_VisualOnly" or not reclaimRidgeForCastle(arena) then return nil end
 end

-- GQ470_FB015_RIDGE_HORIZON_P0_20261120
-- Visual-only horizon cliffs are strictly lower priority than all baseline
-- terrain/ruin visuals and every current or future castle ornament.
-- At most twelve noncolliding wedges; castles may reclaim them on budget hit.
local function drawHorizonRidges(arena:Instance,art:Instance,ground:(number,number)->Vector3)
 local bucket=ridgeVisuals[arena]
 -- A scene may be repainted; keep one bounded ridge set per arena, never 12 more.
 if bucket then return end
 bucket={}
 ridgeVisuals[arena]=bucket
 -- The arena teardown releases both its reference and decorative-Part list.
 arena.Destroying:Once(function()
  ridgeVisuals[arena]=nil
 end)
 -- Three unequal stepped profiles, mirrored by shore without repeating
 -- identical silhouettes. Each side has six matte, nonphysical Wedges.
 local ridgeContours = {
  {height=14,yaw=-19,drift=-16,depth=27,lean=-7,notch=3},
  {height=23,yaw=13,drift=8,depth=35,lean=6,notch=1},
  {height=17,yaw=27,drift=19,depth=25,lean=-4,notch=4},
 }
 for _,side in ipairs({-1,1}) do
  for index=1,3 do
   local contour=ridgeContours[index]
   local x=side*410
   local z=(index-2)*270+side*contour.drift
   local at=ground(x,z)
   local h=contour.height+(if side>0 then 3 else 0)
   local turn=side*contour.yaw
   local lean=side*contour.lean
   -- Use existing matte stone palette for subtle depth and directional
   -- contrast. These Color3 blends run once when an arena is built, not
   -- during combat frames; zero new instances or texture fetches.
   local baseTint=darkStone:Lerp(limestone,.07*(index-1))
   local crownTint=limestone:Lerp(darkStone,.08*(3-index))
   -- Reserve both pieces before sculpting a complete profile. If the 320
   -- scene cap is almost full, skip this pair rather than leave a bare wedge.
   if (budgets[arena] or 0)+2<=MAX_VISUAL_PARTS_PER_ARENA then
    local basePart=createVisual(arena,art,"HorizonCliffBase_"..side.."_"..index,"Wedge",
     Vector3.new(18,h,contour.depth),
     CFrame.new(at+Vector3.new(side*contour.notch,h/2,0))
      *CFrame.Angles(math.rad((index-2)*3),math.rad(turn),math.rad(lean)),
     baseTint,Enum.Material.Slate)
    if basePart then
     -- Matched limestone cap penetrates the base: no detached floating crown.
     local crownPart=createVisual(arena,art,"HorizonCliffCrown_"..side.."_"..index,"Wedge",
      Vector3.new(11,4,contour.depth-6),
      CFrame.new(at+Vector3.new(-side*(2+contour.notch*.25),h+.75,side*2))
       *CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-lean),math.rad(-turn*.7),math.rad(-lean*1.4)),
      crownTint,Enum.Material.Limestone)
     if crownPart then
      table.insert(bucket,basePart)
      table.insert(bucket,crownPart)
     else
      -- Defensive rollback for a failed crown allocation; no half cliff.
      basePart:Destroy()
      budgets[arena]=math.max(0,(budgets[arena] or 0)-1)
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
end

-- Match world replacement must release per-arena accounting references.
 arena.Destroying:Connect(function()
  builtArenas[arena]=nil
  budgets[arena]=nil
  trackedArt[arena]=nil
 end)

-- GQ470_FB015_RIDGE_HORIZON_P0_20261120: add only after baseline and present castles.
 drawHorizonRidges(arena,art,onGround)

-- GQ470_FB015_RIDGE_HORIZON_P0_20261120
-- Visual-only horizon cliffs are strictly lower priority than all baseline
-- terrain/ruin visuals and every current or future castle ornament.
-- At most twelve noncolliding wedges; castles may reclaim them on budget hit.
local function drawHorizonRidges(arena:Instance,art:Instance,ground:(number,number)->Vector3)
 local bucket=ridgeVisuals[arena]
 -- A scene may be repainted; keep one bounded ridge set per arena, never 12 more.
 if bucket then return end
 bucket={}
 ridgeVisuals[arena]=bucket
 -- The arena teardown releases both its reference and decorative-Part list.
 arena.Destroying:Once(function()
  ridgeVisuals[arena]=nil
 end)
 -- Three unequal stepped profiles, mirrored by shore without repeating
 -- identical silhouettes. Each side has six matte, nonphysical Wedges.
 local ridgeContours = {
  {height=14,yaw=-19,drift=-16,depth=27,lean=-7,notch=3},
  {height=23,yaw=13,drift=8,depth=35,lean=6,notch=1},
  {height=17,yaw=27,drift=19,depth=25,lean=-4,notch=4},
 }
 for _,side in ipairs({-1,1}) do
  for index=1,3 do
   local contour=ridgeContours[index]
   local x=side*410
   local z=(index-2)*270+side*contour.drift
   local at=ground(x,z)
   local h=contour.height+(if side>0 then 3 else 0)
   local turn=side*contour.yaw
   local lean=side*contour.lean
   -- Use existing matte stone palette for subtle depth and directional
   -- contrast. These Color3 blends run once when an arena is built, not
   -- during combat frames; zero new instances or texture fetches.
   local baseTint=darkStone:Lerp(limestone,.07*(index-1))
   local crownTint=limestone:Lerp(darkStone,.08*(3-index))
   -- Reserve both pieces before sculpting a complete profile. If the 320
   -- scene cap is almost full, skip this pair rather than leave a bare wedge.
   if (budgets[arena] or 0)+2<=MAX_VISUAL_PARTS_PER_ARENA then
    local basePart=createVisual(arena,art,"HorizonCliffBase_"..side.."_"..index,"Wedge",
     Vector3.new(18,h,contour.depth),
     CFrame.new(at+Vector3.new(side*contour.notch,h/2,0))
      *CFrame.Angles(math.rad((index-2)*3),math.rad(turn),math.rad(lean)),
     baseTint,Enum.Material.Slate)
    if basePart then
     -- Matched limestone cap penetrates the base: no detached floating crown.
     local crownPart=createVisual(arena,art,"HorizonCliffCrown_"..side.."_"..index,"Wedge",
      Vector3.new(11,4,contour.depth-6),
      CFrame.new(at+Vector3.new(-side*(2+contour.notch*.25),h+.75,side*2))
       *CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-lean),math.rad(-turn*.7),math.rad(-lean*1.4)),
      crownTint,Enum.Material.Limestone)
     if crownPart then
      table.insert(bucket,basePart)
      table.insert(bucket,crownPart)
     else
      -- Defensive rollback for a failed crown allocation; no half cliff.
      basePart:Destroy()
      budgets[arena]=math.max(0,(budgets[arena] or 0)-1)
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
end

-- Match world replacement must release per-arena accounting references.
 arena.Destroying:Connect(function()
  builtArenas[arena]=nil
  budgets[arena]=nil
  trackedArt[arena]=nil
 end)

 drawHorizonRidges(arena,art,onGround)

-- S1A match-only awakening is a view of the original KO ledger.
-- Concrete Player tokens contain no XP/score and cannot clear a newer round.
local growthPublishedBy:{[Player]:any}=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"}) :: any
local function battleGrowthSnapshot(neutralKOs:number):any
 return {
  stage=if neutralKOs>=4 then 3 elseif neutralKOs>=1 then 2 else 1,
  xp=10*math.min(neutralKOs,8),
  neutralKOs=neutralKOs,
 }
end

-- Own lifecycle connections independently: Host disconnects lifeConnections
 -- before Destroy, which would cancel pending Deferred cleanup callbacks.
 local growthWorld=session.world
 local growthLease={}
 local growthPlayers:{[string]:Player}={}
 local growthConnections:{RBXScriptConnection}={}
 local growthRetired=false
 local function growthRoundLive():boolean
  return not growthRetired and session.world==growthWorld
   and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil
   and growthWorld.Parent~=nil and growthWorld:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
   and all.Parent==growthWorld
 end
 local function growthCurrentPlayer(id:string):Player?
  local player=growthPlayers[id]
  if not growthRoundLive() or not player or growthPublishedBy[player]~=growthLease
   or player.Parent~=Players or Players:GetPlayerByUserId(player.UserId)~=player
   or currentHumanForId(id)~=player then return nil end
  return player
 end
 local function growthCreditAllowed(id:string):boolean
  if not growthRoundLive() then return false end
  local castle=session.rules.castles[id]
  -- Preserve the existing real AI/takeover KO ledger; never publish it to
  -- a replacement human who happens to reuse this numeric UserId.
  return castle~=nil and (castle.isAI==true or growthCurrentPlayer(id)~=nil)
 end
 local function growthRetirePlayer(id:string,player:Player)
  if growthPlayers[id]~=player then return end
  growthPlayers[id]=nil
  if growthPublishedBy[player]~=growthLease then return end
  growthPublishedBy[player]=nil
  if player.Parent==Players and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(player.UserId)==player then
   player:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_GrowthActive",false)
   player:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_BattleStage",1)
   player:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_BattleXP",0)
   labelKo(player,0)
  end
 end
 local function growthRetire()
  if growthRetired then return end
  growthRetired=true
  for _,connection in ipairs(growthConnections) do connection:Disconnect() end
  table.clear(growthConnections)
  for id,player in pairs(growthPlayers) do growthRetirePlayer(id,player) end
 end
 local function publishBattleGrowth(id:string)
  local player=growthCurrentPlayer(id)
  if not player then return end
  local snapshot=battleGrowthSnapshot(kills[id] or 0)
  player:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_BattleStage",snapshot.stage)
  player:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_BattleXP",snapshot.xp)
 end

  for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
   local id=tostring(player.UserId)
   if currentHumanForId(id)==player then
    growthPlayers[id]=player
    growthPublishedBy[player]=growthLease

  end

  end))

	if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= distance then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = distance end
	if not visible and not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end

		end

	if binding.enabledChanged then binding.enabledChanged:Disconnect(); binding.enabledChanged = nil end
	if binding.readyChanged then binding.readyChanged:Disconnect(); binding.readyChanged = nil end
end

local function refreshPeerRelays()

	for _, carrier in ipairs(peers:GetPlayers()) do
		if carrier == player then continue end -- the original own filter owns Enabled for self
		local character = carrier.Character
		local root, prompt = findRelay(character)

				end

		end

			if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= binding.range then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = binding.range end

local function disconnect(binding: Peer)
	if binding.enabledChanged then binding.enabledChanged:Disconnect(); binding.enabledChanged = nil end
	if binding.readyChanged then binding.readyChanged:Disconnect(); binding.readyChanged = nil end
end

local sweep = 0
local function refreshPeerRelays()
	sweep += 1
	local viewer = getViewer()
	for _, carrier in ipairs(peers:GetPlayers()) do
		if carrier == player then continue end -- the original own filter owns Enabled for self
		local character = carrier.Character
		local root, prompt = findRelay(character)
		if not character or not root or not prompt or type(prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute)) ~= "number" then continue end
		local binding = tracked[prompt]
		if not binding or not binding.enabledChanged or binding.carrier ~= carrier
			or binding.character ~= character or binding.root ~= root then
			local range = if binding then binding.range else prompt.MaxActivationDistance
			if range <= 0 then continue end
			if binding then disconnect(binding) end
			local nextBinding: Peer = { carrier = carrier, character = character, root = root, prompt = prompt,
				range = range, seen = sweep }
			tracked[prompt] = nextBinding
			local function changed()
				-- An event that was queued for an old body or binding cannot act on a replacement.
				if tracked[prompt] == nextBinding and nextBinding.enabledChanged then
					refreshPeer(nextBinding, getViewer())
				end
			end
			nextBinding.enabledChanged = prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(changed)
			nextBinding.readyChanged = prompt:GetAttributeChangedSignal(readyAttribute):Connect(changed)
			binding = nextBinding
		end
		binding.seen = sweep
		refreshPeer(binding, viewer)
	end

		if binding.seen == sweep then continue end
		disconnect(binding)

			if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= binding.range then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = binding.range end

		end

end

-- Ordinary wand contact has its own horizontal approach; the original impact circle keeps its aim and height.
 local function closeWandTest(pose:CFrame?,center:Vector3,radius:number):((Vector3)->boolean)?
  if not pose or radius~=5 then return nil end
  local look=pose.LookVector
  local length=math.sqrt(look.X*look.X+look.Z*look.Z)
  if length<.01 then return nil end
  local ux,uz=look.X/length,look.Z/length
  local start=pose.Position
  -- At this point a level radius-five circle already covers the full two-stud half-width.
  -- The existing neutral-only weapon pickup adds at most 3.5 to the wand's 11-stud reach.
  local limit=math.min((center-start).Magnitude,14.5)-math.sqrt(21)
  return function(target:Vector3):boolean
   if math.abs(target.Y-start.Y)>5 then return false end
   local x,z=target.X-start.X,target.Z-start.Z
   local forward=x*ux+z*uz
   return forward>=1 and forward<=limit and math.abs(z*ux-x*uz)<=math.min(2,forward*.5)
  end
 end

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local relayName = "EGGRUMBLE_ClassicEggRelay"
type CharacterWatch = {
	character: Model,
	added: RBXScriptConnection?,
	removing: RBXScriptConnection?,
	relays: { [ProximityPrompt]: RBXScriptConnection },
}
local current: CharacterWatch?

local function clearCharacter()
	local old = current
	if not old then return end
	current = nil
	if old.added then old.added:Disconnect() end
	if old.removing then old.removing:Disconnect() end
	for _, connection in pairs(old.relays) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
end

local function watchCharacter(character: Model)
	if player.Character ~= character or (current and current.character == character) then return end
	clearCharacter()
	local watch: CharacterWatch = {character = character, added = nil, removing = nil, relays = {}}
	current = watch

	local function consider(instance: Instance)
		if not instance:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or instance.Name ~= relayName then return end
		local root = instance.Parent
		if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart")
			or root.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" or root.Parent ~= character then return end
		if watch.relays[instance] then return end

		local function hideOwnRelay()
			if current == watch and player.Character == character
				and instance.Parent == root and root.Parent == character and instance.Enabled then
				instance.Enabled = false
			end
		end
		watch.relays[instance] = instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(hideOwnRelay)
		hideOwnRelay()
	end

	watch.added = character.DescendantAdded:Connect(consider)
	watch.removing = character.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(instance)
		if not instance:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return end
		local connection = watch.relays[instance]
		if not connection then return end
		watch.relays[instance] = nil
		connection:Disconnect()
	end)
	for _, instance in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		consider(instance)
	end
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(watchCharacter)
player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
	if current and current.character == character then
		clearCharacter()
	end
end)
if player.Character then
	watchCharacter(player.Character)
end

-- Host availability and its transport order belong to the server. Apply the
-- local view through separate properties, without writing a peer's Enabled.

local teamAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationTeam"

	carrier: Player,

	range: number,
	enabledChanged: RBXScriptConnection?,

}
local tracked: { [ProximityPrompt]: Peer } = {}

local function findRelay(character: Model?): (BasePart?, ProximityPrompt?)
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return nil, nil end
	local prompt = root:FindFirstChild(relayName)
	if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return root, nil end
	return root, prompt
end

local function liveTeamPlayer(actor: Player, character: Model): boolean
	if not character.Parent or actor:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_QueuedMode") ~= "TEAM"
		or actor:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Eliminated") == true then return false end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function getViewer(): Viewer?
	local character = player.Character
	if not character or not liveTeamPlayer(player, character) then return nil end
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_LOBBY_CASTLE_MODES_PREVIEW")
	local arena = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("TEAM_Arena")
	if not arena or arena:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase") ~= "ACTIVE" then return nil end
	local root, prompt = findRelay(character)
	if not root or not prompt then return nil end
	local round = prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute)
	local team = prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute)

local function vec(x, y, z)
    return {X = x, Y = y, Z = z}
end
local function matrixProduct(a, b)
    local result = {}
    for row = 0, 2 do
        for col = 1, 3 do
            result[row * 3 + col] = a[row * 3 + 1] * b[col]
                + a[row * 3 + 2] * b[3 + col] + a[row * 3 + 3] * b[6 + col]
        end
    end
    return result
end
local identity = {1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1}
local function transform(a, p)
    return vec(a[1]*p.X+a[2]*p.Y+a[3]*p.Z, a[4]*p.X+a[5]*p.Y+a[6]*p.Z, a[7]*p.X+a[8]*p.Y+a[9]*p.Z)
end
local frameMethods = {}
local function frame(p, r)
    return setmetatable({p = p, r = r}, frameMethods)
end
frameMethods.__mul = function(a, b)
    local p = transform(a.r, b.p)

    local rx = {1,0,0,0,cx,-sx,0,sx,cx}
    local ry = {cy,0,sy,0,1,0,-sy,0,cy}
    local rz = {cz,-sz,0,sz,cz,0,0,0,1}

local function drawHorizonRidges(arena:Instance,art:Instance,ground:(number,number)->Vector3)
 local bucket=ridgeVisuals[arena]
 -- A scene may be repainted; keep one bounded ridge set per arena, never 12 more.
 if bucket then return end
 bucket={}
 ridgeVisuals[arena]=bucket
 -- The arena teardown releases both its reference and decorative-Part list.
 arena.Destroying:Once(function()
  ridgeVisuals[arena]=nil
 end)
 -- Three unequal stepped profiles, mirrored by shore without repeating
 -- identical silhouettes. Each side has six matte, nonphysical Wedges.
 local ridgeContours = {
  {height=14,yaw=-19,drift=-16,depth=27,lean=-7,notch=3},
  {height=23,yaw=13,drift=8,depth=35,lean=6,notch=1},
  {height=17,yaw=27,drift=19,depth=25,lean=-4,notch=4},
 }
 for _,side in ipairs({-1,1}) do
  for index=1,3 do
   local contour=ridgeContours[index]
   local x=side*410
   local z=(index-2)*270+side*contour.drift
   local at=ground(x,z)
   local h=contour.height+(if side>0 then 3 else 0)
   local turn=side*contour.yaw
   local lean=side*contour.lean
   -- Use existing matte stone palette for subtle depth and directional
   -- contrast. These Color3 blends run once when an arena is built, not
   -- during combat frames; zero new instances or texture fetches.
   local baseTint=darkStone:Lerp(limestone,.07*(index-1))
   local crownTint=limestone:Lerp(darkStone,.08*(3-index))
   -- Reserve both pieces before sculpting a complete profile. If the 320
   -- scene cap is almost full, skip this pair rather than leave a bare wedge.
   if (budgets[arena] or 0)+2<=MAX_VISUAL_PARTS_PER_ARENA then
    local basePart=createVisual(arena,art,"HorizonCliffBase_"..side.."_"..index,"Wedge",
     Vector3.new(18,h,contour.depth),
     CFrame.new(at+Vector3.new(side*contour.notch,h/2,0))
      *CFrame.Angles(math.rad((index-2)*3),math.rad(turn),math.rad(lean)),
     baseTint,Enum.Material.Slate)
    if basePart then
     -- Matched limestone cap penetrates the base: no detached floating crown.
     local crownPart=createVisual(arena,art,"HorizonCliffCrown_"..side.."_"..index,"Wedge",
      Vector3.new(11,4,contour.depth-6),
      CFrame.new(at+Vector3.new(-side*(2+contour.notch*.25),h+.75,side*2))
       *CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-lean),math.rad(-turn*.7),math.rad(-lean*1.4)),
      crownTint,Enum.Material.Limestone)
     if crownPart then
      table.insert(bucket,basePart)
      table.insert(bucket,crownPart)
     else
      -- Defensive rollback for a failed crown allocation; no half cliff.
      basePart:Destroy()
      budgets[arena]=math.max(0,(budgets[arena] or 0)-1)
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
end

  budgets[arena]=nil

function Build.coverEnabled():boolean

end

function Build.nextCover(id:string?):(string?,string?)
 local index=if id then table.find(COVER_IDS,id) or 0 else 0
 local selected=COVER_IDS[index+1]
 return selected,if selected then CoverCatalog[selected].name else nil
end

function Build.coverInfo(id:string?):any

local function activeCover(session:any,p:Player):string?
 if not Build.coverEnabled() or not session.builderCoverLoadouts then return nil end

end

local function coverPlan(id:string,stage:number)
 local row=CoverCatalog[id]
 if not row or stage<0 or stage>4 then return nil end
 return {width=row.metrics[1].values[stage+1],life=row.metrics[2].values[stage+1],
  cd=row.cd,energy=row.energy,name=row.name}
end

local function clearEntry(state:any,serial:number)
 local record=state.entries[serial]
 if not record then return end
 state.entries[serial]=nil
 if record.connections then
  for _,connection in ipairs(record.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
 end
 if record.part and record.part.Parent then record.part:Destroy() end
end

local function ownerCover(state:any,userId:number):number?
 for serial,record in pairs(state.entries) do
  if record.cover and record.userId==userId and record.part and record.part.Parent then return serial end
 end
 return nil
end

function Build.clearCover(session:any,p:Player)
 local state=bySession[session]
 local serial=state and ownerCover(state,p.UserId)
 if serial then clearEntry(state,serial) end
end

local function coverGeometry(session:any,root:BasePart,avatar:Model,plan:any,design:any):(CFrame?,Vector3?)
 local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
 local facing=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
 if facing.Magnitude<.15 then return nil,nil end
 facing=facing.Unit
 local aim=root.Position+facing*5.5
 local ground,floor=groundAt(session,aim)
 if not ground or not floor or floor.Parent~=session.world or not floor.Anchored or floor.Name~="TacticalBattlefield"
  or not fieldContains(session,ground) or exclusion(session,ground)
  or math.abs(ground.Y-(root.Position.Y-3))>1.25 then return nil,nil end
 local side=Vector3.new(-facing.Z,0,facing.X)*plan.width*.5
 local a,aFloor=groundAt(session,aim-side)
 local b,bFloor=groundAt(session,aim+side)
 if not a or not b or aFloor~=floor or bFloor~=floor
  or math.abs(a.Y-ground.Y)>.18 or math.abs(b.Y-ground.Y)>.18 then return nil,nil end
 local size=Vector3.new(plan.width,design.height,design.thickness)
 local center=ground+Vector3.new(0,size.Y*.5+.035,0)
 local frame=CFrame.lookAt(center,center+facing)
 if placementBlocked(session,frame,size,true) then return nil,nil end
 local ray=RaycastParams.new()
 ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 ray.FilterDescendantsInstances={avatar}
 ray.RespectCanCollide=true
 if workspace:Raycast(root.Position,center-root.Position,ray) then return nil,nil end
 return frame,size
end

local function coverModel(session:any,p:Player,id:string,frame:CFrame,size:Vector3,stage:number):BasePart
 local design=COVER_DESIGN[id]
 local part=Instance.new("Part")
 part.Name="EGGRUMBLE_BuilderCover_"..design.name
 part.Size=size;part.CFrame=frame;part.Material=design.material;part.Color=design.color
 part.Transparency=if id=="BUILDER-048" then .24 else 0
 part.Anchored=true;part.CanCollide=true;part.CanTouch=false;part.CanQuery=true
 part:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Temporary",true)
 part:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_ConstructOwner",p.UserId)
 part:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_FixedAbilityId",id)
 part:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_ConstructStage",stage)
 part:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_ConstructGuardHits",design.hits)
 for _,sign in ipairs({-1,1}) do
  local support=Instance.new("Part")
  support.Name="CoverSupport";support.Material=Enum.Material.Metal;support.Color=design.accent
  support.Size=Vector3.new(.18,.8,.48)
  support.CFrame=CFrame.new(frame.Position+frame.RightVector*(sign*(size.X*.5-.12))+Vector3.new(0,-size.Y*.5+.42,0))
  support.Anchored=true;support.CanCollide=false;support.CanTouch=false;support.CanQuery=false
  support.Parent=part
 end
 part.Parent=session.world
 return part
end

function Build.placeCover(session:any,p:Player,id:string):boolean
 if activeCover(session,p)~=id then return false end
 local avatar,root=getActor(session,p)
 local humanoid=avatar and avatar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local swarm=session.swarm
 if not avatar or not root or not humanoid or humanoid.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air
  or humanoid.Sit or humanoid.PlatformStand or not swarm or not swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,avatar,"BUILDER") then return false end
 local state=sessionState(session)
 local total,own=count(state,p.UserId)
 if ownerCover(state,p.UserId) or not Policy.capacity(total,own) then return false end
 local snapshot=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
 local plan=snapshot and coverPlan(id,snapshot.stage)
 if not plan then return false end
 local frame,size=coverGeometry(session,root,avatar,plan,COVER_DESIGN[id])
 if not frame or not size or swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,"BUILDER",plan.cd,plan.energy,{[id]=plan.cd})~=snapshot.stage then return false end
 local part=coverModel(session,p,id,frame,size,snapshot.stage)
 state.serial+=1
 local serial=state.serial
 local entry={part=part,userId=p.UserId,actor=p,avatar=avatar,cover=id,hits=COVER_DESIGN[id].hits,
  expires=os.clock()+plan.life,connections={}}
 state.entries[serial]=entry
 local function retire() clearEntry(state,serial) end
 table.insert(entry.connections,humanoid.Died:Connect(retire))
 table.insert(entry.connections,p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(old) if old==avatar then retire() end end))
 table.insert(entry.connections,session.world.Destroying:Connect(retire))
 table.insert(entry.connections,part.Destroying:Connect(function()
  entry.part=nil
  retire()
 end))
 task.delay(plan.life,retire)
 return true
end

-- A real neutral melee ray reached this wall in the existing Swarm tick. Cover
-- hits consume that soldier's normal swing, with no player HP, score or KO.
function Build.impactCover(session:any,part:Instance):boolean
 local state=bySession[session]
 if not state or part.Parent~=session.world then return false end
 for serial,entry in pairs(state.entries) do
  if entry.cover and entry.part==part then
   if activeCover(session,entry.actor)~=entry.cover or entry.expires<=os.clock()
    or getActor(session,entry.actor)~=entry.avatar then clearEntry(state,serial);return false end
   entry.hits-=1
   if entry.hits==0 then clearEntry(state,serial)
   else part:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_ConstructGuardHits",entry.hits) end
   return true
  end
 end
 return false
end

function Build.placeCover(session:any,p:Player,id:string):boolean
 if activeCover(session,p)~=id then return false end
 local avatar,root=getActor(session,p)

 local swarm=session.swarm

  or humanoid.Sit or humanoid.PlatformStand or not swarm or not swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,avatar,"BUILDER") then return false end
 local state=sessionState(session)
 local total,own=count(state,p.UserId)
 if ownerCover(state,p.UserId) or not Policy.capacity(total,own) then return false end
 local snapshot=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
 local plan=snapshot and coverPlan(id,snapshot.stage)
 if not plan then return false end
 local frame,size=coverGeometry(session,root,avatar,plan,COVER_DESIGN[id])

 local part=coverModel(session,p,id,frame,size,snapshot.stage)
 state.serial+=1
 local serial=state.serial
 local entry={part=part,userId=p.UserId,actor=p,avatar=avatar,cover=id,hits=COVER_DESIGN[id].hits,
  expires=os.clock()+plan.life,connections={}}
 state.entries[serial]=entry
 local function retire() clearEntry(state,serial) end
 table.insert(entry.connections,humanoid.Died:Connect(retire))
 table.insert(entry.connections,p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(old) if old==avatar then retire() end end))
 table.insert(entry.connections,session.world.Destroying:Connect(retire))
 table.insert(entry.connections,part.Destroying:Connect(function()
  entry.part=nil
  retire()
 end))
 task.delay(plan.life,retire)
 return true
end

function Build.impactCover(session:any,part:Instance):boolean
 local state=bySession[session]
 if not state or part.Parent~=session.world then return false end
 for serial,entry in pairs(state.entries) do
  if entry.cover and entry.part==part then
   if activeCover(session,entry.actor)~=entry.cover or entry.expires<=os.clock()
    or getActor(session,entry.actor)~=entry.avatar then clearEntry(state,serial);return false end
   entry.hits-=1
   if entry.hits==0 then clearEntry(state,serial)
   else part:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_ConstructGuardHits",entry.hits) end
   return true
  end
 end
 return false
end

  limit=if form.shape=="TRACK" then 1 else secondary,
  turn=if form.shape=="TRACK" then math.rad(secondary) else nil,

 local row=Catalog[id]
 return {cd=row.cd,energy=row.energy,radius=row.metrics[1].values[stage+1],cap=row.metrics[2].values[stage+1],
  reach=if id=="MAGE-073" then 0 else RANGE[stage+1],tell=form.tell,
  overhead=id=="MAGE-078",earthOnly=id=="MAGE-083",icePush=id=="MAGE-015" and stage==4}

function M.route(origin:Vector3,heading:Vector3,reach:number,shape:string)
 local axis=if shape=="VERTICAL" then Vector3.new(0,1,0) else Vector3.new(-heading.Z,0,heading.X)
 local bend=if shape=="VERTICAL" then .115 else .27
 local distance=0
 local old=Vector3.zero
 local route={{point=origin,distance=0}}
 for i=1,SEGMENTS do
  local phase=i/SEGMENTS
  local point=heading*(reach*phase)+axis*(math.sin(math.pi*phase)*reach*bend)
  distance+=(point-old).Magnitude
  route[i+1]={point=point,distance=distance}
  old=point
 end
 local scale=reach/distance
 for i=2,#route do
  route[i].point=origin+route[i].point*scale
  route[i].distance*=scale
 end
 route[#route].distance=reach
 return route
end

function M.turn(forward:Vector3,target:Vector3,limit:number):Vector3
 local flat=Vector3.new(target.X,0,target.Z)
 if flat.Magnitude<.005 then return forward end
 flat=flat.Unit
 local side=Vector3.new(-forward.Z,0,forward.X)
 local angle=math.clamp(math.atan2(flat:Dot(side),flat:Dot(forward)),-limit,limit)
 return forward*math.cos(angle)+side*math.sin(angle)
end

 local gate=math.cos(turn*2)
 for _,target in ipairs(targets) do
  local change=target.center-origin
  local flat=Vector3.new(change.X,0,change.Z)
  if flat.Magnitude>.005 and math.abs(change.Y)<=3 and flat.Unit:Dot(forward)>=gate
   and (flat.Magnitude<distance or (found and flat.Magnitude==distance and target.id<found.id))
   and clear(origin,target.center) then
   found=target;distance=flat.Magnitude
  end

end

type Plan = {

 limit: number, speed: number, width: number, tell: number,
 status: string?, statusDuration: number?, statusPotency: number?,
 shape: string?, element: string?, turn: number?,
}
type Candidate = {

}
type Contact = {target: Candidate, distance: number}
type Flight = {

function MageProjectiles.plan(id: any, stage: any): Plan?
 if type(id)~="string" or type(stage)~="number" or stage<0 or stage>4
  or stage~=math.floor(stage) then return nil end
 local recipe=RECIPES[id]

 local fire=id=="MAGE-001"

  status=if fire then "BURN" elseif frost then "FROST" else nil,
  statusDuration=if fire then FIRE_DURATION[index] elseif frost then 1.4 else nil,
  statusPotency=if frost then FROST_FRACTION[index] else nil,

-- Use the captured launch direction for the entire cast. The caller clamps
-- through the first world collision and only supplies current round neutrals.
function MageProjectiles.travel(plan: Plan, age: number): number
 if age>=plan.tell+plan.reach/plan.speed then return plan.reach end
 return math.max(0,(age-plan.tell)*plan.speed)
end

-- A root bounding sphere intersects this portion of the thin straight path.
-- Contact position, then the server neutral ID order, resolves an exact tie.
function MageProjectiles.contacts(origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3,
 first: number, last: number, width: number, candidates: {Candidate},
 tried: {[any]: boolean}): {Contact}
 local result: {Contact}={}
 if last<=first then return result end
 for _,target in ipairs(candidates) do
  if tried[target.token] then continue end
  local offset=target.center-origin
  local axis=offset:Dot(direction)
  local side=offset-direction*axis
  local thickness=target.radius+width
  local remainder=thickness*thickness-side:Dot(side)
  if remainder<-.000001 then continue end
  local halfSpan=math.sqrt(math.max(0,remainder))
  local entry=axis-halfSpan
  if axis+halfSpan>=first and entry<=last then
   table.insert(result,{target=target,distance=math.max(first,entry)})
  end
 end
 table.sort(result,function(a,b)
  if a.distance==b.distance then return a.target.id<b.target.id end
  return a.distance<b.distance
 end)
 return result
end

function MageProjectiles.newFlight(plan: Plan, origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3): Flight
 return {plan=plan,origin=origin,direction=direction,travelled=0,tried={},hits=0,done=false}
end

-- Use server HP confirmation from the existing swarm authority. World clipping
-- returns an absolute distance along the captured forward direction, if hit.
function MageProjectiles.resolveSegment(flight:Flight,origin:Vector3,direction:Vector3,first:number,last:number,
 blockedAt:boolean,candidates:{Candidate},hit:(Candidate,Vector3)->boolean):number
 if last>first then
  local contacts=MageProjectiles.contacts(origin,direction,first,last,
   flight.plan.width,candidates,flight.tried)
  for _,contact in ipairs(contacts) do
   local target=contact.target
   -- Solid world geometry wins a tie, including the very end of a frame.
   if blockedAt and contact.distance>=last-.00001 then break end
   if flight.tried[target.token] then continue end
   flight.tried[target.token]=true
   if hit(target,origin) then
    flight.hits+=1
    if flight.hits>=flight.plan.limit then
     last=contact.distance
     break
    end
   end
  end
 end
 return last
end

function MageProjectiles.step(flight: Flight, age: number, current: boolean,
 clip: (Vector3,Vector3,number,number)->number?,
 scan: ()->{Candidate}, hit: (Candidate,Vector3)->boolean): number
 if flight.done then return 0 end
 if not current then flight.done=true;return 0 end
 local first=flight.travelled
 local last=MageProjectiles.travel(flight.plan,age)
 if last<=first then return 0 end
 local blockedAt=clip(flight.origin,flight.direction,first,last)
 if blockedAt then last=math.clamp(blockedAt,first,last) end
 local previousHits=flight.hits
 if last>first then last=MageProjectiles.resolveSegment(flight,flight.origin,flight.direction,first,last,blockedAt~=nil,scan(),hit) end
 flight.travelled=last
 flight.done=blockedAt~=nil or last>=flight.plan.reach or flight.hits>=flight.plan.limit
 return flight.hits-previousHits
end

return table.freeze(MageProjectiles)

local M={}
local CHASE,RETURN,GUARD="BEAST-091","BEAST-092","BEAST-093"
local FLAG="P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_BEAST_ORDERS"
local SLOT=table.freeze({A=CHASE,C=RETURN,D=GUARD})
local UP=Vector3.new(0,1,0)
local MAX_ORDERS_TO_CHECK=8

function M.enabled():boolean
 return RunService:IsStudio() and workspace:GetAttribute(FLAG)~=false
end

function M.slot(session:any,player:Player,role:string,slot:string):string?
 if role~="BEAST" or not M.enabled() or not session.beastOrderLoadouts
  or session.beastOrderLoadouts[player.UserId]~=true then return nil end
 return SLOT[slot]
end

function M.presentation(id:string?):any
 return id and Catalog[id] or nil
end

local function horizontal(v:Vector3):Vector3
 return Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z)
end

local function current(bit):boolean
 local session,p,avatar=bit.session,bit.owner,bit.avatar
 local pet=bit.pet.humanoid
 return M.slot(session,p,"BEAST","A")==CHASE and session.swarm==bit.swarm
  and session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==bit.ownerState and bit.arena.Parent==session.world
  and p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_CarryingEgg")~=true and avatar:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Downed")~=true
  and bit.avatarRoot.Parent==avatar and avatar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")==bit.avatarRoot
  and pet.SeatPart==nil and pet.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air and pet.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Water
  and ownedThunderState(session,p,avatar,bit.human,bit.ownerState)==bit.pet
  and bit.swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,avatar,"BEAST")
end

local function sightFilter(bit, target:Model?)
 local actor,pet=bit.avatar,bit.pet.model
 local ray=RaycastParams.new()
 ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 ray.FilterDescendantsInstances=if target then {actor,pet,target} else {actor,pet}
 ray.RespectCanCollide=true
 return ray
end

local function legalFloor(bit, at:Vector3, ray:RaycastParams):Vector3?
 local arena=bit.arena
 local localPoint=arena.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(at)
 if math.abs(localPoint.X)>arena.Size.X*.5-2 or math.abs(localPoint.Z)>arena.Size.Z*.5-2 then return nil end
 local hit=workspace:Raycast(at+UP*2,UP*-8,ray)
 if not hit or hit.Normal.Y<.68 then return nil end
 local surface=hit.Instance
 if not surface:IsA("BasePart") or not surface.Anchored or not surface.CanCollide
  or surface.Parent~=bit.session.world or (surface~=arena and not surface.Name:match("^TacticalRoute_")) then return nil end
 return hit.Position
end

local function destination(bit,wanted:Vector3,target:Model?):Vector3?
 local root=bit.pet.root
 local ray=sightFilter(bit,target)
 local startFloor=legalFloor(bit,root.Position,ray)
 if not startFloor then return nil end
 local height=root.Position.Y-startFloor.Y
 if height<1.1 or height>3.4 then return nil end
 local drift=horizontal(wanted-root.Position)
 if drift.Magnitude>LEASH then return nil end
 local steps=math.max(1,math.ceil(drift.Magnitude/2.4))
 local previous,previousGround=root.Position,startFloor
 local body=Vector3.new(root.Size.X*.83,2.1,root.Size.Z*.83)
 for step=1,steps do
  local check=previous+drift/steps
  local ground=legalFloor(bit,check,ray)
  if not ground or math.abs(ground.Y-previousGround.Y)>.85 then return nil end
  local nextPoint=ground+UP*height
  local nextDelta=nextPoint-previous
  if nextDelta.Magnitude>.05 and workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(previous),body,nextDelta,ray) then return nil end
  previous,previousGround=nextPoint,ground
 end
 return previous
end

local function neutralDestination(bit,target:Model?):Vector3?
 local horde=bit.session.world:FindFirstChild("NeutralHorde")
 local root=target and target.PrimaryPart
 local human=target and target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not target or target.Parent~=horde or not root or not human or human.Health<=0
  or target:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_NeutralFriendlyOwnerId")~=nil then return nil end
 local caster=bit.avatarRoot
 local delta=root.Position-caster.Position
 if delta.Magnitude>bit.reach or math.abs(delta.Y)>4 then return nil end
 local origin=caster.Position+UP
 if workspace:Raycast(origin,root.Position+UP-origin,sightFilter(bit,target)) then return nil end
 local away=horizontal(bit.pet.root.Position-root.Position)
 local wanted=if away.Magnitude>2.7 then root.Position+away.Unit*2.7 else bit.pet.root.Position
 return destination(bit,wanted,target)
end

local function acquireTarget(bit): (Model?,Vector3?)
 local caster=bit.avatarRoot
 local look=horizontal(caster.CFrame.LookVector)
 if look.Magnitude<.01 then return nil,nil end
 look=look.Unit
 local matches={}
 for _,candidate in ipairs(bit.swarm.projectileCandidates(caster.Position,bit.reach)) do
  local delta=horizontal(candidate.center-caster.Position)
  if delta.Magnitude>.1 and delta.Magnitude<=bit.reach and delta.Unit:Dot(look)>=.58 then
   table.insert(matches,{row=candidate,distance=delta.Magnitude})
  end
 end
 table.sort(matches,function(a,b)
  return a.distance==b.distance and a.row.id<b.row.id or a.distance<b.distance
 end)
 for index,match in ipairs(matches) do
  if index>MAX_ORDERS_TO_CHECK then break end
  local model=match.row.token
  local point=neutralDestination(bit,model)
  if point then return model,point end
 end
 return nil,nil
end

local function rally(bit):Vector3
 local caster=bit.avatarRoot
 local distance=if bit.id==RETURN then 2.25 else math.min(bit.reach*.66,3.8)
 local heading=horizontal(caster.CFrame.RightVector)
 if heading.Magnitude<.01 then return caster.Position end
 return caster.Position+heading.Unit*distance
end

local function cue(bit,text:string):BillboardGui
 local board=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
 board.Name="EGGRUMBLE_BeastOrderCue"
 board.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(92,24)
 board.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,3.35,0)
 board.MaxDistance=32
 board.AlwaysOnTop=false
 local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
 label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
 label.BackgroundTransparency=.28
 label.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(42,36,25)
 label.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(251,231,174)
 label.TextScaled=true
 label.Text=text
 label.Parent=board
 board.Parent=bit.pet.root
 return board
end

local function clear(state:any)
 local bit=state.command
 if not bit then return end
 state.command=nil
 if bit.cue then bit.cue:Destroy() end
 if state.root.Parent==state.model and state.humanoid.Parent==state.model then
  state.humanoid:MoveTo(state.root.Position)
 end
end

function M.cancel(player:Player)
 local state=active[player.UserId]
 if state and state.owner==player then clear(state) end
end

M.stop=clear
M.floorAt=legalFloor
M.routeTo=destination

-- The escort's existing movement loop owns every MoveTo. Orders pause autonomous
-- reactions while active; its original attack, cooldown, and lifetime are untouched.
function M.step(state:any):boolean
 local bit=state.command
 if not bit then return false end
 if os.clock()>=bit.untilAt or not current(bit) then clear(state);return true end
 local goal
 if bit.id==CHASE then
  goal=neutralDestination(bit,bit.target)
 elseif bit.id==RETURN then
  if (state.root.Position-bit.avatarRoot.Position).Magnitude<=bit.reach then goal=destination(bit,rally(bit),nil) end
 elseif (bit.avatarRoot.Position-bit.center).Magnitude<=bit.reach and
  horizontal(state.root.Position-bit.center).Magnitude<=bit.reach then
  goal=destination(bit,bit.guardPoint,nil)
 end
 if not goal then clear(state);return true end
 state.humanoid:MoveTo(goal)
 return true
end

function M.cast(session:any,player:Player,avatar:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,owner:any,id:string):boolean
 local row=Catalog[id]
 local swarm=session.swarm
 local state=ownedThunderState(session,player,avatar,h,owner)
 local arena=session.world:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")
 if not row or not state or state.pendingThunder or not swarm or not arena or not arena:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
 local now=os.clock()
 if state.expires-now<=.35 then return false end
 local bit={id=id,session=session,owner=player,avatar=avatar,avatarRoot=root,human=h,pet=state,arena=arena,swarm=swarm,ownerState=owner}
 if not current(bit) then return false end
 local snap=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(player)
 if not snap or snap.role~="BEAST" then return false end
 local index=snap.stage+1
 bit.reach=row.metrics[1].values[index]
 bit.untilAt=math.min(state.expires,now+row.metrics[2].values[index])
 local goal
 if id==CHASE then
  bit.target,goal=acquireTarget(bit)
 elseif id==RETURN then
  if (root.Position-state.root.Position).Magnitude<=bit.reach then goal=destination(bit,rally(bit),nil) end
 else
  bit.center=root.Position
  bit.guardPoint=rally(bit)
  if horizontal(state.root.Position-bit.center).Magnitude<=bit.reach then goal=destination(bit,bit.guardPoint,nil) end
 end
 if not goal or swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(player,"BEAST",row.cd,row.energy,{[id]=row.cd})~=snap.stage then return false end
 clear(state)
 bit.cue=cue(bit,row.name)
 state.command=bit
 state.humanoid:MoveTo(goal)
 task.delay(bit.untilAt-now,function()
  if state.command==bit then clear(state) end
 end)
 return true
end

return M
end)()

local M={}
local CHARGE,GUARD,COMBO="BEAST-020","BEAST-095","COMBO-017"
local FLAG="P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_BEAST_MOON"
local SLOT=table.freeze({A=CHARGE,C=GUARD,D=COMBO})
local UP=Vector3.new(0,1,0)
local TELL=.40
local STEP=.05
local MOTION_SPEED=20
local CONTACT_RADIUS=2.1
local MAX_CHECKED_NEUTRALS=18

function M.enabled():boolean
 return RunService:IsStudio() and workspace:GetAttribute(FLAG)~=false
end

function M.slot(s:any,p:Player,role:string,slot:string):string?
 if role~="BEAST" or not M.enabled() or not s.beastMoonLoadouts or s.beastMoonLoadouts[p.UserId]~=true then return nil end

end

function M.presentation(id:string?,recipes:any):any

  local spec=recipes.resolve("BEAST",CHARGE,GUARD,0)
  return {name=spec.name,description="実際に突進して止まると円陣",energy=spec.proposedEnergy,cd=spec.proposedCooldownSec}
 end

end

local function flat(delta:Vector3):Vector3
 return Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
end

local function current(bit):boolean
 local s,p,avatar=bit.session,bit.owner,bit.avatar
 return M.slot(s,p,"BEAST","A")==CHARGE and s.world==bit.world and s.swarm==bit.swarm
  and s.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==bit.ownerState and bit.arena.Parent==bit.world
  and p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_CarryingEgg")~=true and avatar:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Downed")~=true
  and bit.casterRoot.Parent==avatar and avatar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")==bit.casterRoot
  and ownedThunderState(s,p,avatar,bit.human,bit.ownerState)==bit.pet
  and bit.swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,avatar,"BEAST")
end

local function cue(bit,name:string,size:Vector3,frame:CFrame,color:Color3,shape:Enum.PartType):Part
 local part=Instance.new("Part")
 part.Name=name
 part.Size=size;part.CFrame=frame;part.Color=color;part.Shape=shape
 part.Anchored=true;part.CanCollide=false;part.CanTouch=false;part.CanQuery=false;part.CastShadow=false
 part.Transparency=.60;part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
 part.Parent=bit.world
 return part
end

local function releaseMotion(bit)
 if not bit.ownsAnchor then return end
 bit.ownsAnchor=false
 local root=bit.pet.root
 if root.Parent==bit.pet.model then
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
  root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
  root.Anchored=false
 end
end

local function clear(state:any)
 local bit=state.moon
 if not bit then return end
 state.moon=nil
 if bit.marker then bit.marker:Destroy();bit.marker=nil end
 if bit.sequence then bit.sequence.abort("ESCORT_RETIRED") end
 releaseMotion(bit)
 if state.root.Parent==state.model and state.humanoid.Parent==state.model and state.humanoid.Health>0 then
  state.humanoid:MoveTo(state.root.Position)
 end
end
M.stop=clear

function M.cancel(p:Player)
 local state=active[p.UserId]
 if state and state.owner==p then clear(state) end
end

local function trace(bit,step:string,result:boolean):boolean
 if not bit.sequence then return result end
 local b=bit.binding
 local ok=bit.sequence.advance({binding=b,actor=b.actor,round=b.round,cast=b.cast,phase=step,
  receiptId=b.cast..":"..step,success=result},os.clock())
 return ok and result
end

local function validNeutral(bit,target:Model?):BasePart?
 local horde=bit.world:FindFirstChild("NeutralHorde")
 local root=target and target.PrimaryPart
 local human=target and target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not horde or not target or target.Parent~=horde or not root or not human or human.Health<=0
  or target:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_NeutralFriendlyOwnerId")~=nil then return nil end
 return root
end

local function attack(bit,target:Model,root:BasePart):boolean
 local state=bit.pet
 if not lineClear(state.root.Position+UP*1.85,root.Position+UP,state.model,target) then return false end
 return state.hit(state.root,state.model,root.Position,target)>0
end

local function sweep(bit,from:Vector3,to:Vector3):boolean
 local pet=bit.pet.root
 local body=Vector3.new(pet.Size.X*.88,2.15,pet.Size.Z*.90)
 local change=to-from
 return change.Magnitude>.002 and not workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(from+UP*.1),body,change,bit.ray)
end

local function stillGrounded(bit):boolean
 local pet=bit.pet
 return pet.humanoid.SeatPart==nil and pet.humanoid.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air
  and pet.humanoid.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Water
end

local function formation(bit,point:Vector3):boolean
 local state=bit.pet
 local root=state.root
 if not current(bit) or root.Anchored or not stillGrounded(bit) then return false end
 local floor=Commands.floorAt(bit,point,bit.ray)
 if not floor or (root.Position-point).Magnitude>.44 then return false end
 if bit.marker then bit.marker:Destroy() end
 bit.point=point
 bit.untilAt=math.min(state.expires,os.clock()+bit.guardSec)
 if bit.untilAt<=os.clock() then return false end
 bit.marker=cue(bit,"EGGRUMBLE_BeastMoonFormation",Vector3.new(.075,bit.guardRadius*2,bit.guardRadius*2),
  CFrame.new(floor+UP*.055)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2),Color3.fromRGB(161,149,206),Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
 bit.phase="GUARD"
 state.humanoid:MoveTo(point)
 local published=trace(bit,"FORMATION_VALID",bit.marker.Parent==bit.world)
 if not published then return false end
 task.delay(bit.untilAt-os.clock(),function() if state.moon==bit then clear(state) end end)
 return true
end

function M.step(state:any):boolean
 local bit=state.moon
 if not bit then return false end
 if not current(bit) then clear(state);return true end
 if bit.phase~="GUARD" then return true end
 if os.clock()>=bit.untilAt or not stillGrounded(bit) or flat(state.root.Position-bit.point).Magnitude>bit.guardRadius then
  clear(state);return true
 end
 if (state.root.Position-bit.point).Magnitude>.20 then
  local goal=Commands.routeTo(bit,bit.point,nil)
  if not goal then clear(state);return true end
  state.humanoid:MoveTo(goal)
 end
 if os.clock()-state.lastHit>=ATTACK_COOLDOWN then
  local candidates=bit.swarm.projectileCandidates(state.root.Position,math.min(4,bit.guardRadius))
  table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)
   local origin=state.root.Position
   local left,right=(a.center-origin).Magnitude,(b.center-origin).Magnitude
   return left==right and a.id<b.id or left<right
  end)
  for i,row in ipairs(candidates) do
   if i>MAX_CHECKED_NEUTRALS then break end
   local root=validNeutral(bit,row.token)
   if root and (root.Position-state.root.Position).Magnitude<=4
    and flat(root.Position-bit.point).Magnitude<=bit.guardRadius and attack(bit,row.token,root) then
    state.lastHit=os.clock()
    break
   end
  end
 end
 return true
end

local function aim(bit,origin:Vector3,distance:number): (Vector3?,{any})
 local heading=flat(bit.casterRoot.CFrame.LookVector)
 if heading.Magnitude<.01 then return nil,{} end
 heading=heading.Unit
 local chosen,candidates=nil,{}
 for _,row in ipairs(bit.swarm.projectileCandidates(origin,distance+CONTACT_RADIUS)) do
  local root=validNeutral(bit,row.token)
  if root then

local function charge(bit)
 local state=bit.pet
 local root=state.root
 task.wait(TELL)
 if state.moon~=bit then return end
 if not current(bit) or not stillGrounded(bit) or root.Anchored
  or (root.Position-bit.origin).Magnitude>.3 then clear(state);return end
 -- The same bound lane is checked again when the tell ends.
 if not Commands.routeTo(bit,bit.origin+bit.direction*bit.distance,nil) then clear(state);return end
 if bit.marker then bit.marker:Destroy();bit.marker=nil end
 bit.phase="CHARGE"
 bit.ownsAnchor=true
 root.Anchored=true
 root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
 root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
 local at=bit.origin
 local floor=Commands.floorAt(bit,at,bit.ray)
 if not floor then clear(state);return end
 local height=at.Y-floor.Y
 local started=os.clock()
 local traveled=0
 local attempted={}
 local hits=0
 local readyToHit=os.clock()-state.lastHit>=ATTACK_COOLDOWN
 local didCharge=false
 while traveled<bit.distance do
  task.wait(STEP)
  if state.moon~=bit then return end
  if not current(bit) or not root.Anchored or (root.Position-at).Magnitude>.26 then clear(state);return end
  local nextDistance=math.min(bit.distance,math.max(traveled, (os.clock()-started)*MOTION_SPEED))
  if bit.distance-nextDistance<.001 then nextDistance=bit.distance end
  if nextDistance-traveled>2.4 then clear(state);return end
  local wanted=bit.origin+bit.direction*nextDistance
  local ground=Commands.floorAt(bit,wanted,bit.ray)
  if not ground or math.abs(ground.Y-floor.Y)>.8 then clear(state);return end
  local nextPoint=ground+UP*height
  if not sweep(bit,at,nextPoint) then clear(state);return end
  state.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(nextPoint,nextPoint+bit.direction))
  if (root.Position-nextPoint).Magnitude>.09 then clear(state);return end
  if not didCharge then
   didCharge=trace(bit,"CHARGE_VALID",(nextPoint-at).Magnitude>.02)
   if not didCharge then clear(state);return end
  end
  at,floor,traveled=nextPoint,ground,nextDistance
  if readyToHit and hits<bit.neutralMax then
   for i,item in ipairs(bit.candidates) do
    if i>MAX_CHECKED_NEUTRALS then break end
    local token=item.row.token
    local aimRoot=not attempted[token] and validNeutral(bit,token)
    if aimRoot and flat(aimRoot.Position-at).Magnitude<=CONTACT_RADIUS
     and math.abs(aimRoot.Position.Y-at.Y)<=3 then
     attempted[token]=true
     if attack(bit,token,aimRoot) then
      hits+=1;state.lastHit=os.clock()
      if hits>=bit.neutralMax then break end
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 releaseMotion(bit)
 state.humanoid:MoveTo(at)
 task.wait(STEP)
 if state.moon~=bit then return end
 local stable=current(bit) and not root.Anchored and stillGrounded(bit)
  and (root.Position-at).Magnitude<=.35 and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude<=2
 if not trace(bit,"STOP_VALID",stable==true) then clear(state);return end
 if not bit.sequence or not formation(bit,at) then clear(state) end
end

 if not ground or bit.origin.Y-ground.Y<1.1 or bit.origin.Y-ground.Y>3.4 or state.expires-now<=.30 then return false end
 if charging then
  if state.expires-now<TELL+bit.distance/MOTION_SPEED+.20 or now+TELL-state.lastHit<ATTACK_COOLDOWN then return false end

 if swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,"BEAST",spec.cd,spec.energy,clocks)~=snap.stage then return false end

local Chain=(function()
-- MAGE-025. Only server-owned neutral records are passed to these selectors.
local Chain = {}

Chain.cooldown = 20
Chain.energy = 40
Chain.tellSeconds = 0.24
Chain.targetsByStage = table.freeze({1, 2, 3, 4, 5})
Chain.hopByStage = table.freeze({4, 5, 6, 7, 8})

export type Neutral = {id: number, model: Model, pos: Vector3, hp: number}

function Chain.seed(origin: Vector3, mobs: {Neutral}, allowed: (Neutral) -> boolean): Neutral?
    local chosen: Neutral? = nil
    local nearest = math.huge
    for _, neutral in ipairs(mobs) do
        if neutral.hp <= 0 then continue end
        local distance = (neutral.pos - origin).Magnitude
        if (distance < nearest or (chosen and distance == nearest and neutral.id < chosen.id))
            and allowed(neutral) then
            chosen, nearest = neutral, distance
        end
    end
    return chosen
end

function Chain.path(first: Neutral, mobs: {Neutral}, stage: number,
        clear: (Vector3, Vector3) -> boolean, targetLimit: number?): {Neutral}
    local index = stage + 1
    local limit, reach = Chain.targetsByStage[index], Chain.hopByStage[index]
    if first.hp <= 0 or not limit or not reach then return {} end
    local selected = {first}
    local visited = {[first.model] = true}
    while #selected < math.min(limit,targetLimit or limit) do
        local origin = selected[#selected].pos
        local nextNeutral = Chain.seed(origin, mobs, function(candidate)
            return not visited[candidate.model] and (candidate.pos - origin).Magnitude <= reach
                and clear(origin, candidate.pos)
        end)
        if not nextNeutral then break end
        visited[nextNeutral.model] = true
        table.insert(selected, nextNeutral)
    end
    return selected
end

return table.freeze(Chain)
end)()

 WIND={ja="風",icon="🌀",shape="spiral",palette="mint"},
 EARTH={ja="土",icon="◆",shape="shard",palette="umber"},
 LIGHTNING={ja="雷",icon="⚡",shape="zigzag",palette="yellow"},

local Recipes,Sequence=ComboRecipes,ComboSequence
-- Isolated PRIVATE NINJA-031, NINJA-061 and COMBO-008 donor for HeroCombat.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")

local Combo={}
local FLAG="P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_NINJA_COMBO_008"
local ROLE="NINJA"
local BLINK="NINJA-031"
local SMOKE="NINJA-061"
local ID="COMBO-008"
local FLOOR_TELL=.10 -- local presentation tuning, outside the fixed blink tell
local active=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
local castSerial=0

function Combo.enabled():boolean
 return RunService:IsStudio() and workspace:GetAttribute(FLAG)~=false
end

function Combo.presentation(ability:string)
 if ability==BLINK then return Blink.config.name,Blink.config.energy,Blink.config.cd end
 if ability==SMOKE then return Smoke.name,Smoke.energy,Smoke.cd end
 if ability==ID then
  local plan=Recipes.resolve(ROLE,BLINK,SMOKE,0)
  return plan.name,plan.proposedEnergy,plan.proposedCooldownSec
 end
 return nil
end

local function clear(record)
 local occupied=active[record.player]
 if occupied and occupied[record.ability]==record then
  occupied[record.ability]=nil
  if next(occupied)==nil then active[record.player]=nil end
 end
 for _,connection in ipairs(record.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
 table.clear(record.connections)
 if record.effect then record.effect:Destroy();record.effect=nil end
end

local function localPart(world:Instance,name:string,position:CFrame,size:Vector3,
        color:Color3,transparency:number):Part
 local part=Instance.new("Part")
 part.Name=name
 part.Anchored=true;part.CanCollide=false;part.CanTouch=false;part.CanQuery=false
 part.CastShadow=false
 part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
 part.CFrame=position
 part.Size=size
 part.Color=color
 part.Transparency=transparency
 part.Parent=world
 return part
end

local function supportAt(world:Instance,character:Model,target:Vector3,exactLanding:boolean):(Vector3?,BasePart?)
 local ray=RaycastParams.new()
 ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 ray.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}
 ray.RespectCanCollide=true
 local hit=workspace:Raycast(target,Vector3.new(0,if exactLanding then -4 else -6,0),ray)
 if not hit or not hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(world)
  or not hit.Instance.Anchored or not hit.Instance.CanCollide or hit.Normal.Y<.65
  or (exactLanding and math.abs(target.Y-hit.Position.Y-3)>.02) then return nil,nil end
 return hit.Position,hit.Instance
end

local function smokeFits(arena:BasePart,character:Model,point:Vector3,support:BasePart,radius:number):boolean
 local relative=arena.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
 if math.abs(relative.X)+radius>arena.Size.X*.5 or math.abs(relative.Z)+radius>arena.Size.Z*.5 then
  return false
 end
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
 overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={character,support}
 overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
 overlap.MaxParts=1
 return #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(point+Vector3.new(0,.34,0)),
  Vector3.new(radius*2,.64,radius*2),overlap)==0
end

-- Called by authorized server Tool dispatch with its own registered ability ID.
function Combo.start(session,player:Player,character:Model,root:BasePart,hum:Humanoid,ability:string):boolean
 local moves=ability==BLINK or ability==ID
 local smokes=ability==SMOKE or ability==ID
 if not moves and not smokes then return false end
 if not Combo.enabled() then return false end
 local world=session.world
 local arena=world and world:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")
 local swarm=session.swarm
 local owner=session.rules.castles[tostring(player.UserId)]
 if not arena or not arena:IsA("BasePart") or not swarm or not owner
  or type(swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster)~="function" or type(swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot)~="function"
  or type(swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast)~="function" then return false end
 local function current():boolean
  return workspace:GetAttribute(FLAG)~=false and player.Parent==Players
   and session.world==world and session.swarm==swarm and arena.Parent==world
   and world:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil
   and session.rules.castles[tostring(player.UserId)]==owner and owner.alive==true and (owner.heldEggs or 0)==0
   and player.Character==character and root.Parent==character and hum.Parent==character and hum.Health>0
   and swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(player,character,ROLE) and Blink.isGrounded(hum)
 end
 if not current() then return false end
 local now=os.clock()
 if active[player] and active[player][ability] then return false end
 local snapshot=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(player)
 if not snapshot or snapshot.role~=ROLE then return false end
 local stage=snapshot.stage
 local index=stage+1
 local plan=if ability==ID then Recipes.resolve(ROLE,BLINK,SMOKE,stage) else nil
 if ability==ID and (not plan or plan.id~=ID or plan.flow~="MOVE_THEN_PLACE") then return false end
 local distance=if plan then plan.limits.distance else Blink.config.metrics[1].values[index]
 local moveTell=if plan then plan.telegraphMinSec else Blink.config.metrics[2].values[index]
 local radius=if plan then plan.limits.radius else Smoke.metrics[1].values[index]
 local life=if plan then plan.limits.life else Smoke.metrics[2].values[index]
 local cd=if plan then plan.proposedCooldownSec elseif moves then Blink.config.cd else Smoke.cd
 local energy=if plan then plan.proposedEnergy elseif moves then Blink.config.energy else Smoke.energy
 local deadlines=if plan then {[ID]=cd,[BLINK]=Blink.config.cd,[SMOKE]=Smoke.cd} else {[ability]=cd}
 local origin=root.Position
 local dir,standalonePoint,standaloneSupport
 if moves then
  dir=Blink.direction(root.CFrame.LookVector,root.AssemblyLinearVelocity,hum.WalkSpeed,stage)
  if not dir then return false end
  local reached=Blink.landing(arena,character,origin,dir,distance)
  if not reached or not supportAt(world,character,reached,true) then return false end
 else
  standalonePoint,standaloneSupport=supportAt(world,character,origin,false)
  if not standalonePoint or not standaloneSupport
   or not smokeFits(arena,character,standalonePoint,standaloneSupport,radius) then return false end
 end
 castSerial+=1
 local binding={actor=tostring(player.UserId),round=tostring(session),cast=tostring(castSerial)}
 local sequence=if plan then Sequence.open(plan,binding,now+moveTell+FLOOR_TELL+1,now) else nil
 if plan and not sequence then return false end
 local accepted=swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(player,ROLE,cd,energy,deadlines)
 if accepted==nil then return false end
 if accepted~=stage then
  if sequence then sequence.abort("STAGE_CHANGED") end
  return true
 end
 local record={player=player,ability=ability,connections={},effect=nil}
 local occupied=active[player] or {}
 occupied[ability]=record
 active[player]=occupied
 local function alive():boolean
  return active[player]==occupied and occupied[ability]==record and current()
 end
 local function advance(phase:string,ok:boolean):boolean
  local valid=true
  if sequence then
   valid=sequence.advance({binding=binding,actor=binding.actor,round=binding.round,
    cast=binding.cast,receiptId=binding.cast..":"..phase,phase=phase,success=ok},os.clock())
  end
  if not valid or not ok then clear(record);return false end
  return true
 end
 local function retire()
  if sequence then sequence.abort("RETIRED") end
  clear(record)
 end
 table.insert(record.connections,hum.Died:Connect(retire))
 table.insert(record.connections,player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(removed)
  if removed==character then retire() end
 end))
 table.insert(record.connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_Role"):Connect(function()
  if player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Role")~=ROLE then retire() end
 end))
 table.insert(record.connections,Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(leaving)
  if leaving==player then retire() end
 end))
 table.insert(record.connections,world.Destroying:Connect(retire))
 table.insert(record.connections,world:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase"):Connect(function()
  if session.rules.phase~="ACTIVE" or world:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase")~="ACTIVE" then retire() end
 end))
 table.insert(record.connections,workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal(FLAG):Connect(function()
  if workspace:GetAttribute(FLAG)==false then retire() end
 end))
 local function place(landing:Vector3,point:Vector3,support:BasePart)
  if not smokeFits(arena,character,point,support,radius) then
   advance("PLACEMENT_VALID",false);return
  end
  record.effect=localPart(world,"P0D_NINJA_COMBO_SMOKE_TELL",CFrame.new(point+Vector3.new(0,.07,0)),
   Vector3.new(1.2,.08,1.2),Color3.fromRGB(150,132,174),.45)
  task.delay(FLOOR_TELL,function()
   if not alive() then retire();return end
   if record.effect then record.effect:Destroy();record.effect=nil end
   local checkPoint,checkSupport=supportAt(world,character,landing,moves)
   if not checkPoint or checkSupport~=support or (checkPoint-point).Magnitude>.05
    or not smokeFits(arena,character,point,support,radius) then
    advance("PLACEMENT_VALID",false);return
   end
   -- The existing TwinBiomes translucency and a local low band leave warnings visible.
   local band=localPart(world,"P0D_NINJA_COMBO_LOW_SMOKE",CFrame.new(point+Vector3.new(0,.34,0)),
    Vector3.new(radius*2,.64,radius*2),Color3.fromRGB(139,136,151),.85)
   band.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
   record.effect=band
   if not advance("PLACEMENT_VALID",band.Parent==world) then return end
   task.delay(life,function() clear(record) end)
  end)
 end
 if standalonePoint and standaloneSupport then
  place(origin,standalonePoint,standaloneSupport)
  return true
 end
 if not dir then retire();return true end
 local warn=origin+dir*1.45-Vector3.new(0,1.25,0)
 record.effect=localPart(world,"P0D_NINJA_COMBO_BLINK_TELL",CFrame.lookAt(warn,warn+dir),
  Vector3.new(.72,.12,2.6),Color3.fromRGB(113,84,158),.2)
 task.delay(moveTell,function()
  if not alive() then retire();return end
  if record.effect then record.effect:Destroy();record.effect=nil end
  local drift=root.Position-origin
  if drift.Magnitude>4.5 or (drift-dir*drift:Dot(dir)).Magnitude>.6 then
   advance("MOVE_VALID",false);return
  end
  local landing=Blink.landing(arena,character,root.Position,dir,distance)
  local point,support
  if landing then point,support=supportAt(world,character,landing,true) end
  if not landing or not point or not support then advance("MOVE_VALID",false);return end
  for _,other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
   local avatar=other.Character
   local otherRoot=avatar and avatar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   local otherHum=avatar and avatar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
   if other~=player and otherRoot and otherRoot:IsA("BasePart") and otherHum and otherHum.Health>0
    and (otherRoot.Position-landing).Magnitude<3.2 then advance("MOVE_VALID",false);return end
  end
  -- Same PRIVATE pivot and actual post-pivot pose; no invisibility or damage writes.
  character:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(landing,landing+dir))
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
  root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
  if not advance("MOVE_VALID",(root.Position-landing).Magnitude<=.1) then return end
  if smokes then place(landing,point,support) else clear(record) end
 end)
 return true
end
return table.freeze(Combo),Blink
end)()

local LandThenAttack=(function()
-- Private combat flight owns its avatar only during a checked, finite sweep.
local LandThenAttack={}
local flying=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local BODY=Vector3.new(2.6,4.6,2.6) -- Existing checked Ninja body volume.
local BODY_CENTER=Vector3.new(0,.3,0)
local STEP=1/24

function LandThenAttack.active(actor:Player):boolean
 return flying[actor]~=nil
end

local function footprint(world:Instance,avatar:Model)
 local rays=RaycastParams.new()
 rays.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 rays.FilterDescendantsInstances={avatar}
 rays.RespectCanCollide=true
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
 overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={avatar}
 overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
 overlap.MaxParts=1
 local function floor(at:Vector3,referenceY:number):Vector3?
  local beam=Vector3.new(at.X,referenceY+2.5,at.Z)
  local hit=workspace:Raycast(beam,Vector3.new(0,-5,0),rays)
  if not hit or not hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not hit.Instance.Anchored or not hit.Instance.CanCollide
   or not hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(world) or hit.Normal.Y<.65 or math.abs(hit.Position.Y-referenceY)>1.2 then return nil end
  return hit.Position
 end
 local function sweep(a:Vector3,b:Vector3):boolean
  local change=b-a
  if change.Magnitude>.001 and workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(a+BODY_CENTER),BODY,change,rays) then return false end
  return #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(b+BODY_CENTER),BODY,overlap)==0
 end
 return floor,sweep,rays
end

local function cuePart(world:Instance,name:string,size:Vector3,color:Color3):Part
 local part=Instance.new("Part")
 part.Name=name
 part.Size=size
 part.Anchored=true
 part.CanCollide=false
 part.CanTouch=false
 part.CanQuery=false
 part.CastShadow=false
 part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
 part.Transparency=.28
 part.Color=color
 part.Parent=world
 return part
end

local function placementCue(world:Instance,position:Vector3):Part
 local cue=cuePart(world,"EGGRUMBLE_WingLandingTell",Vector3.new(.075,3.7,3.7),Color3.fromRGB(164,205,224))
 cue.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
 cue.Transparency=.64
 cue.CFrame=CFrame.new(position+Vector3.new(0,.06,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2)
 return cue
end

function LandThenAttack.landingRing(world:Instance,position:Vector3)

 ring.Name="EGGRUMBLE_WingLandingRing"
 ring.Size=Vector3.new(.075,8,8)
 task.delay(.28,function() ring:Destroy() end)
end

-- A pinned arc with bounded server-observed steering; each proposed segment is
-- checked just like the existing traversal vehicle, before the avatar can move.
function LandThenAttack.start(ctx):boolean
 local actor,avatar,root,hum=ctx.actor,ctx.avatar,ctx.root,ctx.humanoid
 local world,arena=ctx.world,ctx.arena
 if flying[actor] or root.Anchored or not ctx.current() or not ctx.grounded(hum)
  or not ctx.inside(arena,root.Position) then return false end
 local base=root.Position
 local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
 local forward=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
 if forward.Magnitude<.01 then return false end
 forward=forward.Unit
 local floor,sweep,rays=footprint(world,avatar)
 local start=workspace:Raycast(base,Vector3.new(0,-6,0),rays)
 if not start or not start.Instance:IsDescendantOf(world) then return false end
 local startGround=floor(base,start.Position.Y)
 if not startGround then return false end
 local rootHeight=base.Y-startGround.Y
 if rootHeight<2.3 or rootHeight>5.5 then return false end
 local function waypoint(xz:Vector3,u:number):(Vector3?,Vector3?)
  if not ctx.inside(arena,xz) then return nil,nil end
  local ground=floor(xz,startGround.Y)
  if not ground then return nil,nil end
  local y=math.min(base.Y+ctx.height,ground.Y+rootHeight+ctx.height*math.sin(math.pi*u))
  return Vector3.new(ground.X,y,ground.Z),ground
 end
 -- Avoid charging into a known wall/ceiling/illegal destination. The same
 -- checks run on every actual segment, including inputs after the warning.
 local previous=base
 local nominalLanding
 for index=1,8 do
  local u=index/8
  local at,under=waypoint(base+forward*(ctx.distance*u),u)
  if not at or not sweep(previous,at) then return false end
  previous,nominalLanding=at,under
 end
 local stage=ctx.authorize()
 if stage==nil then return false end
 local record={root=root}
 flying[actor]=record
 root.Anchored=true
 root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
 root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
 local builder=ctx.flightSkin=="BUILDER"
 local warrior=ctx.flightSkin=="WARRIOR"
 local ninja=ctx.flightSkin=="NINJA"
 local wingColor=if builder then Color3.fromRGB(228,194,112)
  elseif warrior then Color3.fromRGB(240,204,118) elseif ninja then Color3.fromRGB(87,77,115) else Color3.fromRGB(159,186,218)
 local wingSize=if builder then Vector3.new(1.6,.24,1.65) else Vector3.new(1.48,.14,.67)
 local wings={cuePart(world,if builder then "EGGRUMBLE_BuilderThrusterLeft" elseif warrior then "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorWingLeft" elseif ninja then "EGGRUMBLE_NinjaWingLeft" else "EGGRUMBLE_WingLeft",wingSize,wingColor),
              cuePart(world,if builder then "EGGRUMBLE_BuilderThrusterRight" elseif warrior then "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorWingRight" elseif ninja then "EGGRUMBLE_NinjaWingRight" else "EGGRUMBLE_WingRight",wingSize,wingColor)}
 local mark=placementCue(world,nominalLanding)
 local function moveWings()
  for i,wing in ipairs(wings) do
   local side=2*i-3
   local frame=if builder then CFrame.new(side*.85,-2.20,0) else CFrame.new(side*1.11,.75,.62)
   wing.CFrame=root.CFrame*frame*CFrame.Angles(0,side*.22,side*.27)
  end
 end
 moveWings()
 local function release()
  if flying[actor]~=record then return end
  flying[actor]=nil
  root.Anchored=false
  for _,wing in ipairs(wings) do wing:Destroy() end
  mark:Destroy()
 end
 local started=os.clock()
 local usedFlight=false
 task.spawn(function()
  local last,track,xz=base,forward,base
  local lastU=0
  while lastU<1 do
   task.wait(STEP)
   if not ctx.current() or not root.Anchored or (root.Position-last).Magnitude>.6 then
    release();ctx.abort();return
   end
   local input=hum.MoveDirection
   if input then
    local lateral=Vector3.new(input.X,0,input.Z)
    if lateral.Magnitude>.1 then
     local candidate=lateral.Unit
     if candidate:Dot(forward)>=.5 then track=candidate end
    end
   end
   local u=math.clamp((os.clock()-started)/ctx.duration,0,1)
   if 1-u<.00001 then u=1 end
   local traveled=ctx.distance*(u-lastU)
   -- A stalled frame must not skip the apex and cross an unchecked ceiling.
   if u-lastU>.35 then release();ctx.abort();return end
   xz+=track*traveled
   local aim,under=waypoint(xz,u)
   if not aim or not under or not sweep(last,aim) then release();ctx.abort();return end
   avatar:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(aim,aim+track))
   if (root.Position-aim).Magnitude>.08 then release();ctx.abort();return end
   if not usedFlight then
    usedFlight=ctx.trace("FLIGHT_VALID",true)
    if not usedFlight then release();ctx.abort();return end
   end
   moveWings()
   local projected=xz+track*(ctx.distance*(1-u))
   local _,atFoot=waypoint(projected,1)
   if atFoot then mark.CFrame=CFrame.new(atFoot+Vector3.new(0,.06,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2) end
   last,lastU=aim,u
  end
  -- Geometry has already moved the actual avatar to the checked floor.
  -- Permit physics to ground it before attack and reject movement to another tile.
  root.Anchored=false
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
  root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
  task.wait(STEP)
  local settled=floor(root.Position,startGround.Y)
  local stable=ctx.current() and not root.Anchored and settled and ctx.grounded(hum)
   and (root.Position-last).Magnitude<=.35 and math.abs(root.Position.Y-settled.Y-rootHeight)<=.35
  release()
  if not stable or not ctx.trace("LAND_VALID",true) then ctx.abort();return end
  ctx.onLand(settled,stage)
 end)
 return true
end

return table.freeze(LandThenAttack)
end)()
