    -- It catches torso, low and overhead obstructions and narrow gate jambs.
    local right=Vector3.new(-facing.Z,0,facing.X)

    local body=Vector3.new(3.2,4.5,3.2)
    local sweep=workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(origin),body,facing*distance,ray)
    if sweep then distance=math.min(distance,math.max(0,sweep.Distance-.35)) end

    local ground=workspace:Raycast(projected+Vector3.new(0,6,0),Vector3.new(0,-17,0),ray)
    if not ground or not ground.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not ground.Instance.Anchored
        or not ground.Instance.CanCollide or ground.Normal.Y<.65 then return nil end

    overlap.RespectCanCollide=true

  character:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(landing,landing+dir))
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero

  if not advance("MOVE_VALID",(root.Position-landing).Magnitude<=.1) then return end

local LandThenAttack=(function()
-- Private combat flight owns its avatar only during a checked, finite sweep.
local LandThenAttack={}
local flying=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local BODY=Vector3.new(2.6,4.6,2.6) -- Existing checked Ninja body volume.
local BODY_CENTER=Vector3.new(0,.3,0)
local STEP=1/24

function LandThenAttack.active(actor:Player):boolean

local function footprint(world:Instance,avatar:Model)
 local rays=RaycastParams.new()
 rays.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 rays.FilterDescendantsInstances={avatar}
 rays.RespectCanCollide=true
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
 overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={avatar}
 overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
 overlap.MaxParts=1
 local function floor(at:Vector3,referenceY:number):Vector3?
  local beam=Vector3.new(at.X,referenceY+2.5,at.Z)
  local hit=workspace:Raycast(beam,Vector3.new(0,-5,0),rays)
  if not hit or not hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not hit.Instance.Anchored or not hit.Instance.CanCollide
   or not hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(world) or hit.Normal.Y<.65 or math.abs(hit.Position.Y-referenceY)>1.2 then return nil end
  return hit.Position
 end
 local function sweep(a:Vector3,b:Vector3):boolean
  local change=b-a
  if change.Magnitude>.001 and workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(a+BODY_CENTER),BODY,change,rays) then return false end
  return #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(b+BODY_CENTER),BODY,overlap)==0
 end
 return floor,sweep,rays
end

-- A pinned arc with bounded server-observed steering; each proposed segment is
-- checked just like the existing traversal vehicle, before the avatar can move.
function LandThenAttack.start(ctx):boolean

 local world,arena=ctx.world,ctx.arena
 if flying[actor] or root.Anchored or not ctx.current() or not ctx.grounded(hum)
  or not ctx.inside(arena,root.Position) then return false end
 local base=root.Position
 local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
 local forward=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
 if forward.Magnitude<.01 then return false end
 forward=forward.Unit
 local floor,sweep,rays=footprint(world,avatar)
 local start=workspace:Raycast(base,Vector3.new(0,-6,0),rays)
 if not start or not start.Instance:IsDescendantOf(world) then return false end
 local startGround=floor(base,start.Position.Y)
 if not startGround then return false end
 local rootHeight=base.Y-startGround.Y
 if rootHeight<2.3 or rootHeight>5.5 then return false end
 local function waypoint(xz:Vector3,u:number):(Vector3?,Vector3?)
  if not ctx.inside(arena,xz) then return nil,nil end
  local ground=floor(xz,startGround.Y)
  if not ground then return nil,nil end
  local y=math.min(base.Y+ctx.height,ground.Y+rootHeight+ctx.height*math.sin(math.pi*u))
  return Vector3.new(ground.X,y,ground.Z),ground
 end
 -- Avoid charging into a known wall/ceiling/illegal destination. The same
 -- checks run on every actual segment, including inputs after the warning.
 local previous=base
 local nominalLanding
 for index=1,8 do
  local u=index/8
  local at,under=waypoint(base+forward*(ctx.distance*u),u)
  if not at or not sweep(previous,at) then return false end
  previous,nominalLanding=at,under
 end
 local stage=ctx.authorize()
 if stage==nil then return false end
 local record={root=root}
 flying[actor]=record
 root.Anchored=true
 root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
 root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
 local builder=ctx.flightSkin=="BUILDER"
 local warrior=ctx.flightSkin=="WARRIOR"
 local ninja=ctx.flightSkin=="NINJA"
 local wingColor=if builder then Color3.fromRGB(228,194,112)
  elseif warrior then Color3.fromRGB(240,204,118) elseif ninja then Color3.fromRGB(87,77,115) else Color3.fromRGB(159,186,218)
 local wingSize=if builder then Vector3.new(1.6,.24,1.65) else Vector3.new(1.48,.14,.67)
 local wings={cuePart(world,if builder then "EGGRUMBLE_BuilderThrusterLeft" elseif warrior then "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorWingLeft" elseif ninja then "EGGRUMBLE_NinjaWingLeft" else "EGGRUMBLE_WingLeft",wingSize,wingColor),
              cuePart(world,if builder then "EGGRUMBLE_BuilderThrusterRight" elseif warrior then "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorWingRight" elseif ninja then "EGGRUMBLE_NinjaWingRight" else "EGGRUMBLE_WingRight",wingSize,wingColor)}
 local mark=placementCue(world,nominalLanding)
 local function moveWings()
  for i,wing in ipairs(wings) do
   local side=2*i-3
   local frame=if builder then CFrame.new(side*.85,-2.20,0) else CFrame.new(side*1.11,.75,.62)
   wing.CFrame=root.CFrame*frame*CFrame.Angles(0,side*.22,side*.27)
  end
 end
 moveWings()
 local function release()
  if flying[actor]~=record then return end
  flying[actor]=nil
  root.Anchored=false
  for _,wing in ipairs(wings) do wing:Destroy() end
  mark:Destroy()
 end
 local started=os.clock()
 local usedFlight=false
 task.spawn(function()
  local last,track,xz=base,forward,base
  local lastU=0
  while lastU<1 do
   task.wait(STEP)
   if not ctx.current() or not root.Anchored or (root.Position-last).Magnitude>.6 then
    release();ctx.abort();return
   end
   local input=hum.MoveDirection
   if input then
    local lateral=Vector3.new(input.X,0,input.Z)
    if lateral.Magnitude>.1 then
     local candidate=lateral.Unit
     if candidate:Dot(forward)>=.5 then track=candidate end
    end
   end
   local u=math.clamp((os.clock()-started)/ctx.duration,0,1)
   if 1-u<.00001 then u=1 end
   local traveled=ctx.distance*(u-lastU)
   -- A stalled frame must not skip the apex and cross an unchecked ceiling.
   if u-lastU>.35 then release();ctx.abort();return end
   xz+=track*traveled
   local aim,under=waypoint(xz,u)
   if not aim or not under or not sweep(last,aim) then release();ctx.abort();return end
   avatar:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(aim,aim+track))
   if (root.Position-aim).Magnitude>.08 then release();ctx.abort();return end
   if not usedFlight then
    usedFlight=ctx.trace("FLIGHT_VALID",true)
    if not usedFlight then release();ctx.abort();return end
   end
   moveWings()
   local projected=xz+track*(ctx.distance*(1-u))
   local _,atFoot=waypoint(projected,1)
   if atFoot then mark.CFrame=CFrame.new(atFoot+Vector3.new(0,.06,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2) end
   last,lastU=aim,u
  end
  -- Geometry has already moved the actual avatar to the checked floor.
  -- Permit physics to ground it before attack and reject movement to another tile.
  root.Anchored=false
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
  root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
  task.wait(STEP)
  local settled=floor(root.Position,startGround.Y)
  local stable=ctx.current() and not root.Anchored and settled and ctx.grounded(hum)
   and (root.Position-last).Magnitude<=.35 and math.abs(root.Position.Y-settled.Y-rootHeight)<=.35
  release()
  if not stable or not ctx.trace("LAND_VALID",true) then ctx.abort();return end
  ctx.onLand(settled,stage)
 end)
 return true
end

return table.freeze(LandThenAttack)
end)()

    and p.Character==char and root.Parent==char and h.Parent==char and h.Health>0 and h.SeatPart==nil
    and swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,char,ROLE)
  end
  if not current() then return false end
  local stage=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
  local choice=stage and plan(id,stage.stage)
  if not choice then return false end
  local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
  local heading=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
  if heading.Magnitude<.001 then return false end
  heading=heading.Unit
  local origin=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)
  local began=os.clock()
  local binding={round=tostring(session),actor=tostring(p.UserId),cast=tostring(serial)}
  local timeline=if choice.contract then ComboSequence.open(choice.contract,binding,began+choice.tell+.65,began) else nil
  if choice.contract and not timeline then return false end
  if swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,ROLE,choice.cd,choice.energy,choice.deadlines)~=stage.stage then return false end

  local function impact()
   local now=os.clock()
   if not current() or (root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)-origin).Magnitude>3
    or now<began+choice.tell or (timeline and not timeline.expire(now)) then
    if timeline then timeline.abort("STALE_OR_MOVED") end
    return
   end
   local hits,registered=0,false
   local rows=swarm.projectileCandidates(origin,choice.reach)
   table.sort(rows,function(a,b)
    local first,second=(a.center-origin).Magnitude,(b.center-origin).Magnitude
    if first~=second then return first<second end
    return (tonumber(a.id) or math.huge)<(tonumber(b.id) or math.huge)
   end)
   local center=if id==IGNITE then origin+heading*choice.reach else origin
   -- One existing neutral HP budget per target. The compound never invokes the
   -- two component attacks independently. Its first eligible burn is the only one.
   local amount=CombatBalance.skill(ROLE,"A").damage
   for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
    if hits>=choice.maxTargets then break end
    if (row.center-origin).Magnitude<=choice.reach and AttackGeometry.allowed(origin,center,row.center,
        choice.reach,if id==IGNITE then "BLADE" else "CIRCLE") then
     local connected,lit=swarm.damageWarriorNeutral(p,char,row.token,origin,amount,
      if not registered then choice.burn else nil)
     if connected then hits+=1 end
     registered=registered or lit
    end
   end
   if timeline then
    local function receipt(phase:string,success:boolean)
     return timeline.advance({actor=binding.actor,round=binding.round,cast=binding.cast,binding=binding,
      phase=phase,receiptId=binding.cast..":"..phase,success=success},now)
    end
    if receipt("ATTACK_VALID",hits>0) and hits>0 then receipt("STATUS_VALID",registered) end
   end
   blades(world,id,origin,heading,choice.reach,.23,false)
   if hits>0 then ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,ROLE,slot,hits) end
  end

  if choice.tell==0 then impact();return true end
  local work={cue=blades(world,id,origin,heading,choice.reach,choice.tell+.1,true),timeline=timeline}
  pending[p]=work
  task.delay(choice.tell,function()
   if pending[p]~=work then return end
   pending[p]=nil
   if work.cue.Parent then work.cue:Destroy() end
   impact()
  end)
  return true
 end
 return M
end)()

local BuilderPrivateCannon=(function()
-- ACTIVE 0159bb3 supplies placement, timings, direction split and hit budget.
-- This adapter leaves PRIVATE Swarm as the only neutral HP and KO authority.
local BuilderPrivateCannon={}
local VOLUME=Vector3.new(4,5,4)
local DAMAGE=14
local MAX_Y=5

local function findPlacement(ctx,launch:Vector3,facing:Vector3)
 local ray=RaycastParams.new()
 ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 ray.FilterDescendantsInstances={ctx.avatar,ctx.world:FindFirstChild("NeutralHorde")}
 ray.RespectCanCollide=true
 local forward=launch+facing*9
 if not ctx.inside(ctx.arena,forward) then return nil end
 local ground=workspace:Raycast(forward+Vector3.new(0,4,0),Vector3.new(0,-13,0),ray)
 if not ground or ground.Normal.Y<.65 or not ground.Instance:IsA("BasePart")
  or not ground.Instance.Anchored or not ground.Instance.CanCollide
  or ground.Instance.Parent~=ctx.world
  or (ground.Instance~=ctx.arena and not ground.Instance.Name:match("^TacticalRoute_"))
  or math.abs(ground.Position.Y-(launch.Y-3))>3.5 then return nil end
 local center=ground.Position+Vector3.new(0,2.55,0)
 if workspace:Raycast(launch,center-launch,ray) then return nil end
 local frame=CFrame.lookAt(center,center+facing)
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
 overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances=ray.FilterDescendantsInstances
 overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
 overlap.MaxParts=1
 if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(frame,VOLUME,overlap)>0 then return nil end
 return frame,ground.Instance,ray
end

local function createRig(world:Instance,frame:CFrame,stage:number):BasePart
 local rig=Instance.new("Part")
 rig.Name="EGGRUMBLE_BuilderTwinCannon"
 rig.Size=VOLUME
 rig.Anchored=true
 rig.CanCollide=false
 rig.CanTouch=false
 rig.CanQuery=false
 rig.CastShadow=false
 rig.Material=Enum.Material.Slate
 rig.Color=Color3.fromRGB(228,194,112)
 rig.CFrame=frame
 rig:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_BuilderCannonStage",stage)
 rig.Parent=world
 return rig
end

local function beam(rig:BasePart,startAt:Vector3,stopAt:Vector3)
 local start=Instance.new("Attachment")
 local stop=Instance.new("Attachment")
 start.Position=rig.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(startAt);start.Parent=rig
 stop.Position=rig.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(stopAt);stop.Parent=rig
 local warning=Instance.new("Beam")
 warning.Attachment0=start
 warning.Attachment1=stop
 warning.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(246,174,76))
 warning.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(.55)
 warning.Width0=.14
 warning.Width1=.08
 warning.FaceCamera=true
 warning.Parent=rig
 return function() warning:Destroy();stop:Destroy();start:Destroy() end
end

function BuilderPrivateCannon.begin(ctx):boolean
 if not ctx.current() or not ctx.grounded(ctx.humanoid) then return false end
 local origin=ctx.root.Position
 local aim=ctx.root.CFrame.LookVector
 local facing=Vector3.new(aim.X,0,aim.Z)
 if facing.Magnitude<.01 then return false end
 facing=facing.Unit
 local frame,support,rays=findPlacement(ctx,origin,facing)
 if not frame or not support or not rays then return false end
 local stage=ctx.authorize()
 if stage==nil then return false end
 local range=CannonConfig.range[stage+1]
 local budget=CannonConfig.targets[stage+1]
 local used=0
 local seen={}
 local rig=createRig(ctx.world,frame,stage)
 local connections={}
 local retired=false
 local function retire()
  if retired then return end
  retired=true
  for _,connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
  rig:Destroy()
 end
 table.insert(connections,ctx.world.Destroying:Connect(retire))
 table.insert(connections,ctx.world:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase"):Connect(function()
  if ctx.world:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase")~="ACTIVE" then retire() end
 end))
 table.insert(connections,ctx.humanoid.Died:Connect(retire))
 table.insert(connections,workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal(ctx.flag):Connect(function()
  if workspace:GetAttribute(ctx.flag)==false then retire() end
 end))
 local muzzle=frame.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.1,0)
 local started=os.clock()
 local function clear(a:Vector3,b:Vector3):boolean
  return (b-a).Magnitude<=.001 or workspace:Raycast(a,b-a,rays)==nil
 end
 for index,direction in ipairs(CannonConfig.directions(facing)) do
  local delta=direction*range
  local obstacle=workspace:Raycast(muzzle,delta,rays)
  if obstacle then delta=obstacle.Position-muzzle end
  local endWarning=beam(rig,muzzle,muzzle+delta)
  task.delay(CannonConfig.shotTimes[index],function()
   if retired or rig.Parent~=ctx.world then return end
   endWarning()
   if os.clock()>=started+CannonConfig.lifetime or not ctx.current() or not ctx.grounded(ctx.humanoid)
    or (ctx.root.Position-origin).Magnitude>28 then retire();return end
   local currentFrame,currentSupport=findPlacement(ctx,origin,facing)
   if not currentFrame or currentSupport~=support or (currentFrame.Position-frame.Position).Magnitude>.05 then
    retire();return
   end
   local slots=math.min(budget-used,if index==1 then math.ceil(budget/2) else budget-used)
   if slots<=0 then return end
   local available={}
   local fromCaster=ctx.root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)
   for _,target in ipairs(ctx.swarm.projectileCandidates(muzzle,range)) do
    local offset=target.center-muzzle
    local horizontal=Vector3.new(offset.X,0,offset.Z)
    local distance=offset.Magnitude
    if not seen[target.token] and horizontal.Magnitude>.001 and distance<=range
     and math.abs(offset.Y)<=MAX_Y and direction:Dot(horizontal.Unit)>=CannonConfig.aimDot
     and clear(muzzle,target.center) and clear(fromCaster,target.center) then
     table.insert(available,{target=target,distance=distance})
    end
   end
   table.sort(available,function(a,b)
    if a.distance==b.distance then return a.target.id<b.target.id end
    return a.distance<b.distance
   end)
   local hits=0
   for _,row in ipairs(available) do
    local target=row.target
    if ctx.swarm.damageFromPlayer(ctx.player,target.center,.02,DAMAGE,"CIRCLE",nil,target.token,muzzle)>0 then
     used+=1;hits+=1
     seen[target.token]=true
     if hits>=slots then break end
    end
   end
   if hits>0 then ctx.feedback(hits) end
  end)
 end
 task.delay(CannonConfig.lifetime,retire)
 return true
end

return table.freeze(BuilderPrivateCannon)
end)()

 local arena=world and world:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")

 end

   swarm=swarm,flag=BUILDER_FLAG,grounded=GroundMovement.isGrounded,inside=GroundMovement.inside,

   feedback=function(hits) ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,"BUILDER","B",hits) end,

 end
 if id==BUILDER_CANNON_ID then

 local plan=if id==BUILDER_COMBO_ID then ComboRecipes.resolve("BUILDER",BUILDER_FLIGHT_ID,BUILDER_CANNON_ID,stage) else nil
 if id==BUILDER_COMBO_ID and (not plan or plan.flow~="LAND_THEN_ATTACK" or plan.limits.neutralMax~=CannonConfig.targets[stage+1]) then

  return sequence.advance({binding=binding,actor=binding.actor,round=binding.round,cast=binding.cast,
   phase=phase,success=success,receiptId=binding.cast..":"..phase},os.clock())
 end
 return LandThenAttack.start({actor=p,avatar=avatar,root=root,humanoid=h,world=world,arena=arena,
  current=current,grounded=GroundMovement.isGrounded,inside=GroundMovement.inside,flightSkin="BUILDER",

  end,
  abort=function() if sequence then sequence.abort("FLIGHT_INTERRUPTED") end end,
  trace=trace,

local function orbVisual(world:Instance,center:Vector3,radius:number,stage:number,lifetime:number):Model
    local group=Instance.new("Model")
    group.Name="P0D_TRAPPER_GRAVITY_ORB"
    local function inert(part:BasePart,at:CFrame,size:Vector3,color:Color3,material:Enum.Material)
        part.Size=size
        part.CFrame=at
        part.Color=color
        part.Material=material
        part.Anchored=true
        part.CanCollide=false
        part.CanTouch=false
        part.CanQuery=false
        part.CastShadow=false
        part.Parent=group
    end
    local ring=Instance.new("Part")
    ring.Name="GravityRadiusTell"
    ring.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
    ring.Transparency=.78
    inert(ring,CFrame.new(center-Vector3.new(0,1.72,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi*.5),
        Vector3.new(.10,radius*2,radius*2),Color3.fromRGB(106,119,177),Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
    for side=-1,1,2 do
        local facet=Instance.new("WedgePart")
        facet.Name="DarkOreFacet"
        inert(facet,CFrame.new(center+Vector3.new(side*.22,0,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi*(side+1)*.5,0),
            Vector3.new(.62,.84,.74),Color3.fromRGB(43,46,66),Enum.Material.Slate)
    end
    for i=1,stage+1 do
        local yaw=(i-1)*2*math.pi/(stage+1)
        local shard=Instance.new("WedgePart")
        shard.Name="SilverOrbitalShard"
        local offset=Vector3.new(math.cos(yaw)*.92,.18+math.sin(yaw)*.14,math.sin(yaw)*.92)
        inert(shard,CFrame.new(center+offset)*CFrame.Angles(.30,yaw,.22),
            Vector3.new(.23,.48,.30),Color3.fromRGB(155,169,196),Enum.Material.Metal)
    end
    group.Parent=world
    game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(group,lifetime)
    return group
end

 function M.cancel(p:Player)
  local work=pending[p]
  if not work then return end
  pending[p]=nil
  if work.sequence then work.sequence.abort("RETIRED") end
  for _,connection in ipairs(work.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
  if work.pulled then work.swarm.releaseGravity(p,work.avatar,work.pulled,work.token,os.clock(),false) end
  if work.cue then work.cue:Destroy() end
 end

 function M.cancelReturn(p:Player)
  local work=pending[p]
  if work and work.ability~=ID then M.cancel(p) end
 end

 function M.start(session:any,p:Player,char:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,owner:any,ability:string,slot:string):boolean
  local swarm=session.swarm
  local world=session.world
  if pending[p] or not swarm or type(swarm.gravityPlan)~="function" then return false end
  local function current():boolean
   return M.slot(session,p,"TRAPPER",slot)==ability and currentHumanMember(session,p)
    and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil and session.world==world and world.Parent~=nil and session.swarm==swarm
    and session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==owner and owner.alive and (owner.heldEggs or 0)==0
    and p.Character==char and root.Parent==char and h.Parent==char and h.Health>0 and h.SeatPart==nil
    and swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,char,"TRAPPER")
  end
  if not world or not current() then return false end
  local gravity=swarm.gravityPlan(p,char)
  if not gravity then return false end
  local returns=ability~=ID
  local compound=ability==COMBO_ID
  local plan=if compound then ComboRecipes.resolve("TRAPPER",ID,RETURN_ID,gravity.stage) else nil
  if compound and (not plan or plan.flow~="CONTROL_THEN_RETURN" or plan.limits.neutralMax~=gravity.limit) then return false end
  local stage=gravity.stage
  local sample,limit
  if returns then
   if type(swarm.trapperReturnSample)~="function" or not GroundMovement.isGrounded(h) then return false end
   sample=swarm.trapperReturnSample(p,char,ReturnCatalog.metrics[1].values[stage+1])
   limit=ReturnCatalog.metrics[2].values[stage+1]
   if not sample or not checkedReturn(world,char,root,sample,limit) then return false end
  end
  local initial=root.Position
  local at,center
  if ability~=RETURN_ID then
   local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
   local flat=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
   if flat.Magnitude<.001 then return false end
   at=initial+flat.Unit*gravity.placement
   center=swarm.gravityCenter(p,char,initial,at)
   if not center then return false end
  end
  local now=os.clock()
  local binding={actor=tostring(p.UserId),round=tostring(session),cast=tostring((castSequence[p.UserId] or 0)+1)}
  local sequence=if plan then ComboSequence.open(plan,binding,now+gravity.tell+gravity.release+RETURN_TELL+.55,now) else nil
  if plan and not sequence then return false end
  local cooldown=if plan then plan.proposedCooldownSec elseif returns then ReturnCatalog.cd else gravity.cooldown
  local energy=if plan then plan.proposedEnergy elseif returns then ReturnCatalog.energy else gravity.energy
  local deadlines=if plan then {[COMBO_ID]=cooldown,[ID]=gravity.cooldown,[RETURN_ID]=ReturnCatalog.cd} else {[ability]=cooldown}
  if swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,"TRAPPER",cooldown,energy,deadlines)~=stage then return false end
  local work={ability=ability,swarm=swarm,avatar=char,cue=nil,pulled=nil,token=nil,sequence=sequence,connections={}}
  pending[p]=work
  local function trace(step:string,success:boolean):boolean
   if not sequence then return success end
   return sequence.advance({binding=binding,actor=binding.actor,round=binding.round,cast=binding.cast,
    phase=step,success=success,receiptId=binding.cast..":"..step},os.clock())
  end
  local function cancel() if pending[p]==work then M.cancel(p) end end
  if returns then
   table.insert(work.connections,h.Died:Connect(cancel))
   table.insert(work.connections,p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(leaving) if leaving==char then cancel() end end))
   table.insert(work.connections,world.Destroying:Connect(cancel))
   table.insert(work.connections,world:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase"):Connect(function()
    if world:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase")~="ACTIVE" then cancel() end
   end))
  end
  local function actualDestination():Vector3?
   if current() and sample and GroundMovement.isGrounded(h) and swarm.trapperReturnCurrent(p,char,sample) then
    return checkedReturn(world,char,root,sample,limit)
   end
   return nil
  end
  local function warnReturn()
   if not actualDestination() then cancel();return end
   if work.cue then work.cue:Destroy() end
   work.cue=footMark(world,sample.entry.ground,false)
   task.delay(RETURN_TELL,function()
    if pending[p]~=work then return end
    local destination=actualDestination()
    if not destination then cancel();return end
    local delta=destination-root.Position
    -- Translate the current model only, preserving its actual heading and momentum.
    char:PivotTo(char:GetPivot()+delta)
    local moved=(root.Position-destination).Magnitude<=.08
    if moved and trace("RETURN_VALID",true) then
     work.sequence=nil
     Debris:AddItem(footMark(world,sample.entry.ground,true),.28)
    end
    cancel()
   end)
  end
  if ability==RETURN_ID then warnReturn();return true end
  work.cue=orbVisual(world,center,gravity.range,stage,gravity.tell+gravity.release+.10)
  task.delay(gravity.tell,function()
   if pending[p]~=work then return end
   local fresh=if current() and (root.Position-initial).Magnitude<=6 then swarm.gravityCenter(p,char,root.Position,at) else nil
   if not fresh or (fresh-center).Magnitude>.15 then cancel();return end
   local pullAt=os.clock()
   local token={world=world,expires=pullAt+gravity.release+.15}
   work.token=token
   work.pulled=swarm.pullGravity(p,char,center,stage,pullAt,token)
   if #work.pulled==0 then
    if compound then cancel() else pending[p]=nil end
    return
   end
   if compound then
    local moved=false
    for _,capture in ipairs(work.pulled) do
     local actual=capture.model.PrimaryPart
     if actual and (actual.Position-capture.position).Magnitude<=.08
      and (actual.Position-capture.previous).Magnitude>.01 then moved=true;break end
    end
    if not moved or not trace("CONTROL_VALID",true) then cancel();return end
   end
   task.delay(gravity.release,function()
    if pending[p]~=work then return end
    local pulled=work.pulled
    work.pulled=nil
    local released=swarm.releaseGravity(p,char,pulled,token,os.clock(),current() and (root.Position-initial).Magnitude<=6)
    if not compound then pending[p]=nil;return end
    if released<1 then cancel();return end
    warnReturn()
   end)
  end)
  return true
 end
 return M
end)()

local SKY_ROLE="WARRIOR"
local SKY_FLIGHT="WARRIOR-060"
local SKY_RAIN="WARRIOR-020"
local SKY_COMBO="COMBO-001"
local SKY_FLAG="P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_WARRIOR_COMBO_001"
local RAIN_TELL=1
local HALF_FAN=math.rad(44)
local FAN_DOT=math.cos(HALF_FAN)
local slots=table.freeze({B=SKY_RAIN,C=SKY_FLIGHT,D=SKY_COMBO})
local pending=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local M={}

function M.enabled():boolean
 return RunService:IsStudio() and workspace:GetAttribute(SKY_FLAG)~=false
end

function M.slot(session:any,p:Player,role:string,slot:string):string?
 if role==SKY_ROLE and M.enabled() and session.warriorSkyLoadouts and session.warriorSkyLoadouts[p.UserId] then
  return slots[slot]
 end
 return nil
end

function M.presentation(ability:string?):any
 if ability==SKY_COMBO then
  local recipe=ComboRecipes.resolve(SKY_ROLE,SKY_FLIGHT,SKY_RAIN,0)
  return {name=recipe.name,energy=recipe.proposedEnergy,cd=recipe.proposedCooldownSec}
 end
 return ability and SkyCatalog[ability] or nil
end

local function fanVisual(world:Instance,point:Vector3,direction:Vector3,reach:number,stage:number,warning:boolean):Folder
 local visual=Instance.new("Folder")
 visual.Name=if warning then "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorSkyFanTell" else "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorSkyRainCut"
 local count=if stage==0 then 3 else 5
 local lateral=Vector3.new(-direction.Z,0,direction.X)
 for index=1,count do
  local angle=((index-1)/(count-1)*2-1)*HALF_FAN
  local ray=direction*math.cos(angle)+lateral*math.sin(angle)
  local plank=Instance.new("WedgePart")
  plank.Name="SkyFanBlade"
  plank.Anchored=true;plank.CanCollide=false;plank.CanTouch=false;plank.CanQuery=false;plank.CastShadow=false
  plank.Material=Enum.Material.Metal
  plank.Color=if warning then Color3.fromRGB(229,193,115) else Color3.fromRGB(240,219,170)
  plank.Transparency=if warning then .34 else .15
  plank.Size=if warning then Vector3.new(.13,.065,reach) else Vector3.new(.23,1.05,.7)
  local center=point+Vector3.new(0,if warning then .07 else .60,0)+ray*(reach*(if warning then .5 else .8))
  plank.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(center,center+ray)
  plank.Parent=visual
 end
 visual.Parent=world
 return visual
end

function M.cancel(p:Player)
 local work=pending[p]
 if not work then return end
 pending[p]=nil
 for _,connection in ipairs(work.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
 if work.timeline then work.timeline.abort("RETIRED") end
 work.visual:Destroy()
end

local function floorAt(world:Instance,avatar:Model,root:BasePart):Vector3?
 local params=RaycastParams.new()
 params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 params.FilterDescendantsInstances={avatar}
 params.RespectCanCollide=true
 local under=workspace:Raycast(root.Position,Vector3.new(0,-6,0),params)
 if not under or not under.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not under.Instance.Anchored
  or under.Instance.Parent~=world or under.Normal.Y<.65
  or (under.Instance.Name~="TacticalBattlefield" and not under.Instance.Name:match("^TacticalRoute_")) then return nil end
 return under.Position
end

local function fanDamage(swarm,p,origin:Vector3,heading:Vector3,reach:number,maxTargets:number,amount:number):number
 local rows=swarm.projectileCandidates(origin,reach)
 table.sort(rows,function(left,right)
  local a,b=(left.center-origin).Magnitude,(right.center-origin).Magnitude
  if a==b then return left.id<right.id end
  return a<b
 end)
 local hits=0
 for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
  local delta=row.center-origin
  local lateral=Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
  if lateral.Magnitude>.001 and math.abs(delta.Y)<=4 and heading:Dot(lateral.Unit)>=FAN_DOT
   and AttackGeometry.allowed(origin,origin,row.center,reach,"CIRCLE") then
   if swarm.damageFromPlayer(p,row.center,.02,amount,"CIRCLE",nil,row.token,origin)>0 then
    hits+=1
    if hits>=maxTargets then break end
   end
  end
 end
 return hits
end

function M.cast(session:any,p:Player,avatar:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,owner:any,ability:string,slot:string):boolean
 local world,swarm=session.world,session.swarm
 local arena=world and world:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")
 if not arena or not arena:IsA("BasePart") or not swarm or type(swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster)~="function"
  or type(swarm.projectileCandidates)~="function" or type(swarm.damageFromPlayer)~="function" or pending[p] then return false end
 local function current():boolean
  return M.slot(session,p,SKY_ROLE,slot)==ability and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil
   and session.world==world and world:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and arena.Parent==world and session.swarm==swarm
   and session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==owner and owner.alive==true and (owner.heldEggs or 0)==0
   and p.Character==avatar and root.Parent==avatar and h.Parent==avatar and h.Health>0
   and h.SeatPart==nil and not h.Sit and not h.PlatformStand and swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,avatar,SKY_ROLE)
 end
 if not current() then return false end
 local sample=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
 if not sample or sample.role~=SKY_ROLE then return false end
 local stage=sample.stage
 local flight,rain=SkyCatalog[SKY_FLIGHT],SkyCatalog[SKY_RAIN]
 local plan=if ability==SKY_COMBO then ComboRecipes.resolve(SKY_ROLE,SKY_FLIGHT,SKY_RAIN,stage) else nil
 local cap=rain.metrics[1].values[stage+1]
 local reach=rain.metrics[2].values[stage+1]
 if ability==SKY_COMBO and (not plan or plan.flow~="LAND_THEN_ATTACK" or plan.limits.neutralMax~=cap) then return false end
 local tell=if plan then math.max(RAIN_TELL,plan.telegraphMinSec) else RAIN_TELL
 local duration=flight.metrics[1].values[stage+1]
 local binding={actor=tostring(p.UserId),round=tostring(session),cast=tostring((castSequence[p.UserId] or 0)+1)}
 local now=os.clock()
 local sequence=if plan then ComboSequence.open(plan,binding,now+duration+tell+.75,now) else nil
 if plan and not sequence then return false end
 local function trace(phase:string,success:boolean):boolean
  if not sequence then return success end
  return sequence.advance({binding=binding,actor=binding.actor,round=binding.round,cast=binding.cast,
   phase=phase,success=success,receiptId=binding.cast..":"..phase},os.clock())
 end
 local function heading():Vector3?
  local aim=root.CFrame.LookVector
  local dir=Vector3.new(aim.X,0,aim.Z)
  return if dir.Magnitude>.001 then dir.Unit else nil
 end
 local function startRain(point:Vector3,direction:Vector3)
  local origin=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)
  local commenced=os.clock()
  local work={visual=fanVisual(world,point,direction,reach,stage,true),timeline=sequence,connections={}}
  pending[p]=work
  local function cancel() if pending[p]==work then M.cancel(p) end end
  table.insert(work.connections,h.Died:Connect(cancel))
  table.insert(work.connections,p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(leaving) if leaving==avatar then cancel() end end))
  table.insert(work.connections,world.Destroying:Connect(cancel))
  table.insert(work.connections,world:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase"):Connect(function()
   if world:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase")~="ACTIVE" then cancel() end
  end))
  table.insert(work.connections,workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal(SKY_FLAG):Connect(function()
   if not M.enabled() then cancel() end
  end))
  task.delay(tell,function()
   if pending[p]~=work then return end
   local grounded=GroundMovement.isGrounded(h) and floorAt(world,avatar,root)
   if not current() or not grounded or (root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)-origin).Magnitude>3
    or os.clock()<commenced+tell or not trace("ATTACK_VALID",true) then cancel();return end
   work.timeline=nil
   cancel()
   local hits=fanDamage(swarm,p,origin,direction,reach,cap,CombatBalance.skill(SKY_ROLE,"A").damage)
   Debris:AddItem(fanVisual(world,point,direction,reach,stage,false),.23)
   if hits>0 then ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,SKY_ROLE,slot,hits) end
  end)
 end
 if ability==SKY_RAIN then
  local dir=heading()
  local point=GroundMovement.isGrounded(h) and floorAt(world,avatar,root)
  if not point or not dir or not GroundMovement.inside(arena,root.Position) then return false end
  if swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,SKY_ROLE,rain.cd,rain.energy,{[SKY_RAIN]=rain.cd})~=stage then return false end
  startRain(point,dir)
  return true
 end
 local cooldown=if plan then plan.proposedCooldownSec else flight.cd
 local energy=if plan then plan.proposedEnergy else flight.energy
 local deadlines=if plan then {[SKY_COMBO]=cooldown,[SKY_FLIGHT]=flight.cd,[SKY_RAIN]=rain.cd} else {[SKY_FLIGHT]=flight.cd}
 return LandThenAttack.start({actor=p,avatar=avatar,root=root,humanoid=h,world=world,arena=arena,
  current=current,grounded=GroundMovement.isGrounded,inside=GroundMovement.inside,flightSkin="WARRIOR",
  duration=duration,height=flight.metrics[2].values[stage+1],distance=math.min(CoreAction.SPECS.WARRIOR.dodge.distance,6*duration),
  authorize=function()
   local accepted=swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,SKY_ROLE,cooldown,energy,deadlines)
   return if accepted==stage then accepted else nil
  end,
  abort=function() if sequence then sequence.abort("FLIGHT_INTERRUPTED") end end,
  trace=trace,
  onLand=function(point:Vector3, _acceptedStage:number)
   local dir=heading()
   if not dir or not current() then return end
   if plan then startRain(point,dir);return end
   local spec=CoreAction.SPECS.WARRIOR.basic
   local origin=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)
   local hits=fanDamage(swarm,p,origin,dir,spec.reach,1,spec.damage)
   Debris:AddItem(fanVisual(world,point,dir,spec.reach,stage,false),.23)
   if hits>0 then ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,SKY_ROLE,slot,hits) end
  end,
 })
end

return M
end)()

function M.cast(session:any,p:Player,char:Model,root:BasePart,id:string,serial:number):boolean
 local swarm=session.swarm
 local status=swarm and swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
 if not status or status.role~="ZOMBIE" or not swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,char,"ZOMBIE")
  or p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_CarryingEgg")==true then return false end
 local stage=status.stage
 local plan=if id==COMBO then ComboRecipes.resolve("ZOMBIE",MARK,COMMAND,stage) else nil
 if id==COMBO and (not plan or plan.hold or plan.flow~="CONVERT_THEN_COMMAND") then return false end
 local spec=M.presentation(id)
 local mark,command=Data[MARK],Data[COMMAND]
 local markRange,markTTL=mark.metrics[1].values[stage+1],mark.metrics[2].values[stage+1]
 local cmdTTL,cmdRange=command.metrics[1].values[stage+1],command.metrics[2].values[stage+1]
 if not (spec and markRange and markTTL and cmdTTL and cmdRange) then return false end
 local origin=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)
 local now=os.clock()
 local targets=if id==COMMAND then swarm.zombieOwned(p,char,origin,cmdRange)
  else swarm.zombieCandidates(p,char,origin,markRange,if plan then plan.limits.neutralMax else 1,id==COMBO)
 if #targets==0 then return false end
 local binding={actor=tostring(p.UserId),round=tostring(session.world),cast="ZOMBIE:"..tostring(serial)}
 local deadline=now+markTTL
 local sequence=if plan then ComboSequence.open(plan,binding,deadline,now) else nil
 if plan and not sequence then return false end
 local component=if plan then deadlines else {[id]=spec.cd}
 if swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,"ZOMBIE",spec.cd,spec.energy,component)~=stage then return false end
 if id==COMMAND then
  return swarm.orderCharmed(p,"GUARD",nil,{avatar=char,origin=origin,range=cmdRange,duration=cmdTTL,models=targets})
 end

  swarm.markZombieCandidates(p,char,targets,deadline,nil)

 end

  return sequence.advance({binding=binding,actor=binding.actor,round=binding.round,cast=binding.cast,
   phase=phase,receiptId=binding.cast..":"..phase,success=success},at)
 end

 local commandCount=0
 swarm.markZombieCandidates(p,char,targets,deadline,function(model:Model,at:number)
  -- Only the existing Swarm CHARM decision calls here, once for each chosen same-round Model.
  if p.Character~=char or at>=deadline or commandCount>=plan.limits.neutralMax then return end
  local currentOrigin=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)

  if ordered then commandCount+=1 end

  reach=if exactRange then row.metrics[1].values[index] else RANGE[index],

 end
 part.Parent=world

 pending[p]=nil
 for _,connection in ipairs(work.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
 work.cue:Destroy()
end

  or type(swarm.projectileCandidates)~="function" or type(swarm.damageFromPlayer)~="function" or pending[p] then return false end

  return M.slot(session,p,"MAGE",slot)==id and session.world==world and world:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
   and arena.Parent==world and session.swarm==swarm and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil
   and session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==owner and owner.alive==true and (owner.heldEggs or 0)==0
   and p.Character==avatar and root.Parent==avatar and h.Parent==avatar and h.Health>0

 local origin=root.Position

 heading=heading.Unit

  return (to-from).Magnitude<.02 or workspace:Raycast(from,to-from,rays)==nil
 end
 local function terrain(at:Vector3,rootAt:Vector3):(Vector3?,BasePart?)
  if not GroundMovement.inside(arena,at) then return nil,nil end
  local offset=arena.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(at)
  if math.abs(offset.X)+choice.radius>arena.Size.X*.5 or math.abs(offset.Z)+choice.radius>arena.Size.Z*.5 then return nil,nil end
  local ground=workspace:Raycast(at+Vector3.new(0,4,0),Vector3.new(0,-12,0),rays)
  if not ground or not ground.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not ground.Instance.Anchored or not ground.Instance.CanCollide
   or ground.Instance.Parent~=world or ground.Normal.Y<.65
   or (ground.Instance~=arena and (choice.earthOnly or not ground.Instance.Name:match("^TacticalRoute_")))
   or math.abs(rootAt.Y-ground.Position.Y)>5 then return nil,nil end
  local above=ground.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.65,0)
  if not clear(rootAt+Vector3.new(0,1,0),above) then return nil,nil end
  local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
  overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={ground.Instance,avatar}
  overlap.RespectCanCollide=true;overlap.MaxParts=1
  if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(above),Vector3.new(.7,2.8,.7),overlap)>0 then return nil,nil end
  return ground.Position,ground.Instance
 end
 local aim=origin+heading*choice.reach

 if not point or not support then return false end
 if swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,"MAGE",choice.cd,choice.energy,{[id]=choice.cd})~=snapshot.stage then return false end
 local started=os.clock()
 local work={cue=cue(world,id,point,choice.radius,true),connections={}}
 pending[p]=work

 end))

  local start=point+Vector3.new(0,1.65,0)

  end
  table.sort(rows,function(a,b)
   if a.distance==b.distance then return a.target.id<b.target.id end
   return a.distance<b.distance
  end)
  local actual={}
  for _,row in ipairs(rows) do

     if swarm.damageFromPlayer(p,target.center,.02,amount,"CIRCLE",nil,target.token,start)>0 then
      table.insert(actual,target.center)
      if choice.icePush then swarm.pushMageGroundNeutral(p,avatar,target.token,point,heading,id) end
     end
    end
    if #actual>=choice.cap then break end
   end
  end
  if #actual>0 then
   Debris:AddItem(cue(world,id,point,choice.radius,false),.23)

   end
   ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,"MAGE",slot,#actual)

local function decorativePart(source:BasePart?,name:string):BasePart
  local part:BasePart=if source and source:IsA("WedgePart") then Instance.new("WedgePart") else Instance.new("Part")
  if source and source:IsA("Part") and part:IsA("Part") then part.Shape=source.Shape end
  part.Name=name;part.Anchored=true;part.CanCollide=false;part.CanTouch=false
  part.CanQuery=false;part.CastShadow=false;part.Massless=true
  part.Material=Enum.Material.Glass;part.Color=Color3.fromRGB(162,181,199)
  part.Transparency=.54
  return part
 end

 local function makeDecoy(char:Model,root:BasePart,at:Vector3,role:string):Folder?
  -- Copy supported poses and sizes only. No cloned object, Tool, script,
  -- Humanoid, inherited tag, or model for any AI or hit query to target.
  local folder=Instance.new("Folder")
  folder.Name="EGGRUMBLE_NinjaMovingDecoy"
  folder:SetAttribute("FixedDecoyId",DECOY)
  folder:SetAttribute("VisualRole",role)
  local translate=CFrame.new(at-root.Position)
  local count=0
  local function add(source:Instance?)
   if count>=11 or not source or not source:IsA("BasePart") then return end
   count+=1
   local piece=decorativePart(source,"Mirror_"..source.Name)
   piece.Size=source.Size;piece.CFrame=translate*source.CFrame;piece.Parent=folder
  end
  for _,name in ipairs(BODY) do add(char:FindFirstChild(name)) end
  if count==0 then folder:Destroy();return nil end
  local roleArt=char:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_RoleVisuals")
  if roleArt and roleArt:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_VisualRole")==role then
   for _,piece in ipairs(roleArt:GetChildren()) do add(piece) end
  end
  -- Four silver gaps at the feet distinguish the illusion from the real body.
  for i=1,4 do
   local shard=decorativePart(nil,"MirrorFootShard"..i)
   local angle=i*math.pi*.5
   shard.Size=Vector3.new(.92,.075,.16)
   shard.CFrame=CFrame.new(at+Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*1.3,-2.92,math.sin(angle)*1.3))
    *CFrame.Angles(0,angle+math.pi*.25,0)
   shard.Parent=folder
  end
  return folder
 end

local function visualRoute(world:Instance,arena:BasePart,avatar:Model,base:Vector3)
 if not GroundMovement.inside(arena,base) then return nil,nil end
 local filter={avatar}
 local neutrals=world:FindFirstChild("NeutralHorde")
 if neutrals then table.insert(filter,neutrals) end
 local ray=RaycastParams.new()
 ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 ray.FilterDescendantsInstances=filter
 ray.RespectCanCollide=true
 local function support(position:Vector3):Vector3?
  if not GroundMovement.inside(arena,position) then return nil end
  local hit=workspace:Raycast(position+Vector3.new(0,2,0),Vector3.new(0,-8,0),ray)
  if not hit or not hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(world)
   or not hit.Instance.Anchored or not hit.Instance.CanCollide or hit.Normal.Y<.65 then return nil end
  return hit.Position
 end
 local startFloor=support(base)
 if not startFloor or base.Y-startFloor.Y<2.3 or base.Y-startFloor.Y>5.5 then return nil,nil end
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
 overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances=filter
 overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
 overlap.MaxParts=1
 local box=CFrame.new(base)
 if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(box,SWEEP_BOX,overlap)>0 then return nil,nil end
 return ray,support
end

local function createVisual(p:Player,avatar:Model,root:BasePart,world:Instance,arena:BasePart,
 distance:number,life:number,current:()->boolean,direction:Vector3,authorize:(()->number?)?):boolean
 if active[p] or not current() then return false end
 local base=root.Position
 local ray,support=visualRoute(world,arena,avatar,base)
 if not ray or not support then return false end
 local startFloor=support(base)
 if not startFloor then return false end
 local folder=makeDecoy(avatar,root,base,ROLE)
 if not folder then return false end
 if authorize and authorize()==nil then folder:Destroy();return false end
 local pieces={}
 for _,part in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do table.insert(pieces,{part=part,frame=part.CFrame}) end
 local rec={folder=folder}
 active[p]=rec
 folder.Parent=world
 local began=os.clock()
 task.spawn(function()
  local currentPoint,blocked=base,false
  while active[p]==rec do
   task.wait(STEP)
   local now=os.clock()
   if active[p]~=rec then return end
   if not current() or folder.Parent~=world or now-began>=life then M.clear(p);return end
   if blocked then continue end
   local targetDistance=math.min(distance,(now-began)*distance/(life-STEP))
   local nextHorizontal=base+direction*targetDistance
   local ground=support(nextHorizontal)
   if not ground or math.abs(ground.Y-startFloor.Y)>1.2 then blocked=true;continue end
   local destination=nextHorizontal+Vector3.new(0,ground.Y-startFloor.Y,0)
   local delta=destination-currentPoint
   if delta.Magnitude<=.001 then continue end
   local hit=workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(currentPoint),SWEEP_BOX,delta,ray)
   if hit then
    blocked=true
    destination=currentPoint+delta.Unit*math.max(0,hit.Distance-.08)
   end
   local translate=CFrame.new(destination-base)
   for _,piece in ipairs(pieces) do piece.part.CFrame=translate*piece.frame end
   currentPoint=destination
  end
 end)
 task.delay(life,function() if active[p]==rec then M.clear(p) end end)
 return true
end

function M.cast(session:any,p:Player,avatar:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,owner:any,id:string,serial:number):boolean
 local world,swarm=session.world,session.swarm
 local arena=world and world:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")
 if not arena or not arena:IsA("BasePart") or not swarm then return false end
 local function current():boolean
  return M.slot(session,p,ROLE,"B")==DECOY and p.Parent==Players
   and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil
   and session.world==world and arena.Parent==world and world:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
   and session.swarm==swarm and session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==owner
   and owner.alive==true and (owner.heldEggs or 0)==0 and p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_CarryingEgg")~=true
   and p.Character==avatar and root.Parent==avatar and h.Parent==avatar and h.Health>0
   and avatar:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Downed")~=true and p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Eliminated")~=true
   and h.SeatPart==nil and not h.Sit and not h.PlatformStand and swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,avatar,ROLE)
 end
 if not current() or (id~=FLIGHT and active[p]) then return false end
 local snapshot=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
 local stage=snapshot and snapshot.stage
 if stage==nil or snapshot.role~=ROLE then return false end
 local decoy,flight=Catalog[DECOY],Catalog[FLIGHT]
 local distance,life=decoy.metrics[1].values[stage+1],decoy.metrics[2].values[stage+1]
 local duration,height=flight.metrics[1].values[stage+1],flight.metrics[2].values[stage+1]
 local spec=M.presentation(id)
 local plan=if id==COMBO then ComboRecipes.resolve(ROLE,FLIGHT,DECOY,stage) else nil
 if id==COMBO and (not plan or plan.id~=COMBO or plan.flow~="FLIGHT_VISUAL_DECOY"
  or plan.limits.decoyDist~=distance or plan.limits.decoyLife~=life
  or plan.limits.flightSec~=duration or plan.limits.height~=height) then return false end
 if not spec or not GroundMovement.isGrounded(h) then return false end
 local function direction():Vector3?
  local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
  local flat=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
  return if flat.Magnitude>.01 then flat.Unit else nil
 end
 local cd,energy=if plan then plan.proposedCooldownSec else spec.cd,if plan then plan.proposedEnergy else spec.energy
 local clocks=if plan then {[FLIGHT]=flight.cd,[DECOY]=decoy.cd,[COMBO]=cd} else {[id]=cd}
 local function authorize():number?
  local accepted=swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,ROLE,cd,energy,clocks)
  return if accepted==stage then accepted else nil
 end
 if id==DECOY then
  local dir=direction()
  if root.Anchored or not dir then return false end
  return createVisual(p,avatar,root,world,arena,distance,life,current,dir,authorize)
 end
 local now=os.clock()
 local binding={actor=tostring(p.UserId),round=tostring(session),cast="NINJA-009:"..tostring(serial)}
 local sequence=if plan then ComboSequence.open(plan,binding,now+duration+life+.55,now) else nil
 if plan and not sequence then return false end
 local function trace(phase:string,ok:boolean):boolean
  -- The motor verifies LAND_VALID before it calls onLand. Only catalog receipts advance the combo.
  if not sequence or phase=="LAND_VALID" then return ok end
  local valid=sequence.advance({binding=binding,actor=binding.actor,round=binding.round,cast=binding.cast,
   receiptId=binding.cast..":"..phase,phase=phase,success=ok},os.clock())
  return valid and ok
 end
 return LandThenAttack.start({actor=p,avatar=avatar,root=root,humanoid=h,world=world,arena=arena,
  current=current,grounded=GroundMovement.isGrounded,inside=GroundMovement.inside,
  duration=duration,height=height,distance=math.min(CoreAction.SPECS.NINJA.dodge.distance,6*duration),flightSkin="NINJA",
  authorize=authorize,trace=trace,abort=function() if sequence then sequence.abort("FLIGHT_INTERRUPTED") end end,
  onLand=function(_point:Vector3,_stage:number)
   if not sequence or not sequence.expire(os.clock()) then return end
   local dir=direction()
   local created=dir~=nil and createVisual(p,avatar,root,world,arena,distance,life,current,dir,nil)
   if not trace("DECOY_VALID",created) and created then M.clear(p) end
  end,
 })
end

return M
end)()

local GravityOrb=(function()
--!strict
-- TRAPPER-015 target and motion limits. The existing Horde owns mob positions.
local Orb = {}

Orb.radius = table.freeze({5, 6, 7, 8, 9})
Orb.targets = table.freeze({2, 3, 4, 5, 6})
Orb.cooldown = 24
Orb.energy = 40
Orb.tellSeconds = .30
Orb.releaseSeconds = .32
Orb.placement = 5.5

function Orb.motion(at: Vector3, center: Vector3): (Vector3?, Vector3?)
    local radial = Vector3.new(at.X - center.X, 0, at.Z - center.Z)
    local gap = radial.Magnitude
    if gap <= 1.1 then return nil, nil end
    local outward = radial.Unit
    local tangent = Vector3.new(-outward.Z, 0, outward.X)
    local pull = math.min(3.25, gap - 1.1)
    return -outward * pull + tangent * math.min(.3, pull * .12), outward * 1.75
end

-- #796's continuous body sweep with a tangential retry and final overlap check.
-- This variant receives the existing neutral's body dimensions and world filters.
function Orb.safeStep(at: Vector3, step: Vector3, sweep: (Vector3, Vector3) -> RaycastResult?,
        blockedAt: (Vector3) -> boolean): Vector3?
    if step.Magnitude <= .01 then return nil end
    local hit = sweep(at, step)
    if hit then
        local outward = Vector3.new(hit.Normal.X, 0, hit.Normal.Z)
        if outward.Magnitude < .5 then return nil end
        outward = outward.Unit
        step -= outward * step:Dot(outward)
        if step.Magnitude <= .01 or sweep(at, step) then return nil end
    end
    local last = at + step
    if blockedAt(last) then return nil end
    return last
end

return table.freeze(Orb)
end)()

        position: Vector3?, walkSpeed: number)
    if state.round~=round then return end
    if character==nil or position==nil or not finite(now) or not finite(walkSpeed)
        or not finite(position.X) or not finite(position.Y) or not finite(position.Z) then
        Growth.pause(state)
        return

    if state.character==character and previousAt~=nil and now<=previousAt then return end
    local sameCharacter=state.character==character

 local function closeWandTest(pose:CFrame?,center:Vector3,radius:number):((Vector3)->boolean)?
  if not pose or radius~=5 then return nil end
  local look=pose.LookVector
  local length=math.sqrt(look.X*look.X+look.Z*look.Z)
  if length<.01 then return nil end
  local ux,uz=look.X/length,look.Z/length
  local start=pose.Position
  -- At this point a level radius-five circle already covers the full two-stud half-width.
  -- The existing neutral-only weapon pickup adds at most 3.5 to the wand's 11-stud reach.
  local limit=math.min((center-start).Magnitude,14.5)-math.sqrt(21)
  return function(target:Vector3):boolean
   if math.abs(target.Y-start.Y)>5 then return false end
   local x,z=target.X-start.X,target.Z-start.Z
   local forward=x*ux+z*uz
   return forward>=1 and forward<=limit and math.abs(z*ux-x*uz)<=math.min(2,forward*.5)
  end
 end

 local function gravityRays(character:Model):RaycastParams
  local rays=RaycastParams.new()
  rays.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  rays.FilterDescendantsInstances={character,all}
  rays.RespectCanCollide=true
  return rays

 local function gravityGround(at:Vector3,rays:RaycastParams):RaycastResult?
  if not spawnFloor or not spawnFloor:IsA("BasePart") or spawnFloor.Parent~=session.world
   or not neutralWithinArena(at,spawnFloor) then return nil end
  local ground=workspace:Raycast(at+Vector3.new(0,3,0),Vector3.new(0,-8,0),rays)
  if ground and ground.Normal.Y>=.72 and ground.Instance.CanCollide
   and ground.Instance:IsDescendantOf(session.world) then return ground end
  return nil
 end

 local function gravityMove(model:Model,delta:Vector3,character:Model):Vector3?
  local root=model.PrimaryPart
  if not root or model.Parent~=all then return nil end
  local rays=gravityRays(character)
  local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
  overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances=rays.FilterDescendantsInstances
  overlap.RespectCanCollide=true;overlap.MaxParts=1
  local position=root.Position
  -- Blockcast omits an initial overlap. Do not pull an already embedded body
  -- through the obstacle to reach a clear endpoint.
  if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(position),root.Size,overlap)>0 then return nil end
  local height=2*(root.Size.Y/2.5) -- Existing ground clearance for the neutral rig.
  local function grounded(at:Vector3):Vector3?
   local ground=gravityGround(at,rays)
   if not ground or math.abs(ground.Position.Y+height-position.Y)>1.4 then return nil end
   return Vector3.new(at.X,ground.Position.Y+height,at.Z)
  end
  local function sweep(from:Vector3,step:Vector3):RaycastResult?
   return workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(from),root.Size,step,rays)
  end
  local function blocked(at:Vector3):boolean
   local found=grounded(at)
   return found==nil or (found-at).Magnitude>.15
    or #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(found),root.Size,overlap)>0
  end
  local aimed=grounded(position+delta)
  if not aimed then return nil end
  local safe=GravityOrb.safeStep(position,aimed-position,sweep,blocked)
  if not safe then return nil end
  model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(safe,safe+root.CFrame.LookVector))
  return safe
 end

  local pulled={}

   nextTick=now+duration/3,interval=duration/3,remaining=if fire then amount else 0,
   amount=amount,cue=cue}

 local function updateElementStatus(now:number)
  for target,mark in pairs(elementStatus) do
   local h=live[target]
   for kind,rec in pairs(mark) do
    if not statusEnabled(rec.role,rec.player)
     or target.Parent~=all or not h or h.Health<=0 or charmedByModel[target] or now>=rec.expires
     or not api.isCurrentRoleCaster(rec.player,rec.avatar,rec.role) then
     clearElementStatus(target,kind)
    elseif kind=="BURN" and rec.remaining>0 and now>=rec.nextTick then
     local root=target.PrimaryPart
     local damage=math.min(rec.remaining,math.ceil(rec.amount/2))
     rec.nextTick+=rec.interval

     if root and (root.Position-rec.origin).Magnitude<=18 then
      -- Re-enter the existing Swarm hit/LOS/KO authority. The reserve is

 local function gravityCaster(player:Player,avatar:Model):boolean
  return workspace:GetAttribute("P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_TRAPPER_015")~=false
   and session.trapperGravityLoadouts~=nil and session.trapperGravityLoadouts[player.UserId]==true

 local function gravityRays(character:Model):RaycastParams
  local rays=RaycastParams.new()
  rays.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  rays.FilterDescendantsInstances={character,all}
  rays.RespectCanCollide=true
  return rays
 end

 local function gravityGround(at:Vector3,rays:RaycastParams):RaycastResult?
  if not spawnFloor or not spawnFloor:IsA("BasePart") or spawnFloor.Parent~=session.world
   or not neutralWithinArena(at,spawnFloor) then return nil end
  local ground=workspace:Raycast(at+Vector3.new(0,3,0),Vector3.new(0,-8,0),rays)
  if ground and ground.Normal.Y>=.72 and ground.Instance.CanCollide
   and ground.Instance:IsDescendantOf(session.world) then return ground end
  return nil
 end

 local function gravityMove(model:Model,delta:Vector3,character:Model):Vector3?
  local root=model.PrimaryPart
  if not root or model.Parent~=all then return nil end
  local rays=gravityRays(character)
  local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
  overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances=rays.FilterDescendantsInstances
  overlap.RespectCanCollide=true;overlap.MaxParts=1
  local position=root.Position
  -- Blockcast omits an initial overlap. Do not pull an already embedded body
  -- through the obstacle to reach a clear endpoint.
  if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(position),root.Size,overlap)>0 then return nil end
  local height=2*(root.Size.Y/2.5) -- Existing ground clearance for the neutral rig.
  local function grounded(at:Vector3):Vector3?
   local ground=gravityGround(at,rays)
   if not ground or math.abs(ground.Position.Y+height-position.Y)>1.4 then return nil end
   return Vector3.new(at.X,ground.Position.Y+height,at.Z)
  end
  local function sweep(from:Vector3,step:Vector3):RaycastResult?
   return workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(from),root.Size,step,rays)
  end
  local function blocked(at:Vector3):boolean
   local found=grounded(at)
   return found==nil or (found-at).Magnitude>.15
    or #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(found),root.Size,overlap)>0
  end
  local aimed=grounded(position+delta)
  if not aimed then return nil end
  local safe=GravityOrb.safeStep(position,aimed-position,sweep,blocked)
  if not safe then return nil end
  model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(safe,safe+root.CFrame.LookVector))
  return safe
 end

 api.pullGravity=function(player:Player,avatar:Model,center:Vector3,stage:number,now:number,token:any):any
  local radius,limit=GravityOrb.radius[stage+1],GravityOrb.targets[stage+1]
  if not radius or not limit or token.world~=session.world or not gravityCaster(player,avatar) then return {} end
  local rays=gravityRays(avatar)
  local eligible={}
  for model,h in pairs(live) do
   local root=model.PrimaryPart
   local prior=gravityHeld[model]
   if model.Parent~=all or not root or h.Health<=0 or charmedByModel[model]
    or (prior and prior.expires>now) then continue end
   local offset=root.Position-center
   local distance=Vector3.new(offset.X,0,offset.Z).Magnitude
   local id=tonumber(model:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_NeutralInstanceId"))
   if id and distance<=radius and math.abs(offset.Y)<=3.5 and not workspace:Raycast(center,offset,rays) then
    table.insert(eligible,{model=model,position=root.Position,distance=distance,id=id})
   end
  end
  table.sort(eligible,function(a,b)
   if a.distance==b.distance then return a.id<b.id end
   return a.distance<b.distance
  end)
  local pulled={}
  for _,candidate in ipairs(eligible) do
   if #pulled>=limit then break end
   local inward,outward=GravityOrb.motion(candidate.position,center)
   if inward and outward then
    local at=gravityMove(candidate.model,inward,avatar)
    if at then
     gravityHeld[candidate.model]=token
     table.insert(pulled,{model=candidate.model,position=at,outward=outward,previous=candidate.position})
    end
   end
  end
  if #pulled>0 then
   local state,current=currentRoleGrowth(player,now)
   if state and current==avatar then MatchRoleGrowth.markAction(state,growthLease,now,avatar) end
  end
  return pulled
 end

 api.releaseGravity=function(player:Player,avatar:Model,pulled:any,token:any,now:number,allowed:boolean):number
  local released=0
  local canMove=allowed and token.world==session.world and now<=token.expires and gravityCaster(player,avatar)
  for _,capture in ipairs(pulled) do
   local model=capture.model
   if gravityHeld[model]~=token then continue end
   gravityHeld[model]=nil
   local h,root=live[model],model.PrimaryPart
   if canMove and model.Parent==all and h and h.Health>0 and root and not charmedByModel[model]
    and (root.Position-capture.position).Magnitude<=.15 then
    local before=root.Position
    local after=gravityMove(model,capture.outward,avatar)
    if after and (root.Position-after).Magnitude<=.08 and (root.Position-before).Magnitude>.01 then released+=1 end
   end
  end
  return released
 end

local function wedgeRise(part:BasePart):number
 if not part:IsA("WedgePart") then return 0 end
 if wedgeRiseSign~=nil then return wedgeRiseSign end
 -- Calibrate once with the engine's primitive shape. An interior sample is
 -- returned unchanged. Keep the original box when the API is unavailable or
 -- the two samples cannot distinguish the sloped ends.

  local positiveInside=(part:GetClosestPointOnSurface(positive)-positive).Magnitude<.001
  local negativeInside=(part:GetClosestPointOnSurface(negative)-negative).Magnitude<.001
  if positiveInside==negativeInside then return 0 end
  return if positiveInside then 1 else -1
 end)

 local frame=part.CFrame
 local size=part.Size

 local rise=wedgeRise(part)

 local startAbove=start.Y*scaleY-start.Z*scaleZ

 local tMin,tMax=0,1
 local function clipAxis(origin:number,step:number,radius:number):boolean
  if math.abs(step)<.0001 then return math.abs(origin)<=radius end
  local enter,leave=(-radius-origin)/step,(radius-origin)/step
  if enter>leave then enter,leave=leave,enter end
  tMin,tMax=math.max(tMin,enter),math.min(tMax,leave)

 local roofStep=delta.Y*scaleY-delta.Z*scaleZ

local function cueEnabled(cue:string):boolean
 local spec=extendedCueVisual[cue]
 local flag=if spec then spec.flag else MAGE_PROJECTILE_FLAG
 if workspace:GetAttribute(flag)==false then return false end
 if flag==RETURN_FLAG and workspace:GetAttribute(GRAVITY_FLAG)==false then return false end
 if flag==ELEMENTAL_FLAG or flag==WING_FLAG then
  return workspace:GetAttribute(MAGE_PROJECTILE_FLAG)~=false
   and workspace:GetAttribute(ELEMENTAL_FLAG)~=false
 end
 return true
end

local initialCastSignature=player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_SkillCastSignature")
local lastMageCueSequence=if type(initialCastSignature)=="string"
 then tonumber(string.match(initialCastSignature,":(%d+)$")) or 0 else 0
local mageCueAvatar:Model?=nil
local currentFixedCue:string?=nil
local castCueTween:Tween?=nil
local playMageCueSound:((string,Model)->())?=nil
local stopMageCueSound:(()->())?=nil
local function fixedCastCue(character:Model,role:string,slot:string):string?
 if player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Role")~=role
  or player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_GrowthActive")~=true
  or character:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Downed")==true then return nil end
 local equipped:Tool?=nil
 for _,item in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
  if item:IsA("Tool") then
   if equipped then return nil end
   equipped=item
  end
 end
 if not equipped then return nil end
 local id=equipped:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_FixedAbilityId")
 local rule=if type(id)=="string" then fixedCueByAbility[id] else nil
 if rule then
  return if rule.role==role and rule.slot==slot and cueEnabled(rule.cue) then rule.cue else nil
 end
 if id~=nil or role~="MAGE" or slot~="A" or not cueEnabled("WIND") then return nil end
 -- Previous accepted Tools existed before the fixed-ID publication. Limit this
 -- fallback to the original three Mage recipes and their exact equipped names.
 local legacy=equipped:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_InternalToolId")
 return if type(legacy)=="string" then mageCueByTool[legacy] else nil
end
local function clearMageCue()
 if mageCueAvatar then
  mageCueAvatar=nil
  currentFixedCue=nil
  castCueSerial+=1
  if castCueTween then castCueTween:Cancel();castCueTween=nil end
  castCue.Visible=false
 end
end
local onScopedCueOff={}
for _,flag in ipairs(cueFlags) do
 table.insert(onScopedCueOff,workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal(flag):Connect(function()
  if currentFixedCue and not cueEnabled(currentFixedCue) then
   clearMageCue()
   if stopMageCueSound then stopMageCueSound() end
  end
 end))
end
local onMageCueAvatar=player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
 if mageCueAvatar==character then clearMageCue() end
end)

do
 -- Reuse only the existing #504 assets and an idle voice from its pool.
 -- The original HIT owner may preempt this quiet accent without losing a hit.
 local hitAudio=game:GetService("SoundService"):FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_GQ_ConfirmedHitAudio")
 local voice=hitAudio and hitAudio:FindFirstChild("ConfirmedHit_4")
 if voice and voice:IsA("Sound") then
  local cues={
   WIND={id="rbxasset://sounds/action_jump.mp3",pitch=1.91,volume=.095},
   STONE={id="rbxasset://sounds/action_jump_land.mp3",pitch=.70,volume=.14},
   STAR={id="rbxasset://sounds/impact_water.mp3",pitch=1.62,volume=.092},
  }
  for name,visual in pairs(extendedCueVisual) do cues[name]=visual.audio end
  local lastAt=-math.huge
  local currentCue:string?=nil
  playMageCueSound=function(kind:string,character:Model)
   local cue=cues[kind]
   local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
   local now=os.clock()
   if not cue or not voice.Parent or voice.IsPlaying or now-lastAt<.14
    or player.Character~=character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0
    or player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_SFXMuted")==true
    or player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Eliminated")==true
    or not cueEnabled(kind) then return end
   lastAt=now
   currentCue=kind
   voice:Stop()
   voice.SoundId=cue.id
   voice.PlaybackSpeed=cue.pitch
   voice.Volume=cue.volume
   voice:Play()
  end
  stopMageCueSound=function()
   local cue=if currentCue then cues[currentCue] else nil
   currentCue=nil
   -- A new original hit sets the profile and volume before playing this voice.
   if cue and voice.Parent and voice.SoundId==cue.id
    and voice.PlaybackSpeed==cue.pitch and voice.Volume==cue.volume then voice:Stop() end
  end
 end
end
-- MAGE_PROJECTILE_CAST_AUDIO_END

local receiverReadyAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationReceiverReady"
local rayLift = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.RespectCanCollide = true

type Viewer = { character: Model, root: BasePart, round: number, team: string }
type Peer = {
	carrier: Player,
	character: Model,
	root: BasePart,
	prompt: ProximityPrompt,
	range: number,
	enabledChanged: RBXScriptConnection?,
	readyChanged: RBXScriptConnection?,
	seen: number,
}
local tracked: { [ProximityPrompt]: Peer } = {}

local function findRelay(character: Model?): (BasePart?, ProximityPrompt?)
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return nil, nil end
	local prompt = root:FindFirstChild(relayName)
	if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return root, nil end
	return root, prompt
end

local function liveTeamPlayer(actor: Player, character: Model): boolean
	if not character.Parent or actor:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_QueuedMode") ~= "TEAM"
		or actor:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Eliminated") == true then return false end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

end

local function getViewer(): Viewer?
	local character = player.Character
	if not character or not liveTeamPlayer(player, character) then return nil end
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_LOBBY_CASTLE_MODES_PREVIEW")
	local arena = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("TEAM_Arena")
	if not arena or arena:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase") ~= "ACTIVE" then return nil end
	local root, prompt = findRelay(character)
	if not root or not prompt or prompt:GetAttribute(receiverReadyAttribute) ~= true then return nil end
	local round = prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute)
	local team = prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute)
	if type(round) ~= "number" or (team ~= "RED" and team ~= "BLUE") then return nil end
	return { character = character, root = root, round = round, team = team }
end

local function present(binding: Peer, visible: boolean)
	local prompt = binding.prompt
	if visible and prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false end
	local distance = if visible then binding.range else 0
	if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= distance then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = distance end
	if not visible and not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end
end

local function refreshPeer(binding: Peer, viewer: Viewer?)
	local carrier, character, root, prompt = binding.carrier, binding.character, binding.root, binding.prompt
	if prompt.Parent ~= root or root.Parent ~= character then
		present(binding, false)
		return
	end
	local height = prompt:GetAttribute(heightAttribute)
	local visible = false
	if viewer and carrier.Parent == peers and carrier.Character == character and liveTeamPlayer(carrier, character)
		and prompt.Enabled and prompt:GetAttribute(readyAttribute) == true
		and prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute) == viewer.round and prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute) == viewer.team
		and type(height) == "number" then
		local delta = root.Position - viewer.root.Position
		if math.abs(delta.Y) <= height and delta.Magnitude <= binding.range then
			rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { viewer.character, character }
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(viewer.root.Position + rayLift, delta, rayParams)
			visible = hit == nil or not hit.Instance.CanCollide
		end
	end
	present(binding, visible)
end

local function disconnect(binding: Peer)
	if binding.enabledChanged then binding.enabledChanged:Disconnect(); binding.enabledChanged = nil end
	if binding.readyChanged then binding.readyChanged:Disconnect(); binding.readyChanged = nil end
end

local sweep = 0
local function refreshPeerRelays()
	sweep += 1
	local viewer = getViewer()
	for _, carrier in ipairs(peers:GetPlayers()) do
		if carrier == player then continue end -- the original own filter owns Enabled for self
		local character = carrier.Character
		local root, prompt = findRelay(character)
		if not character or not root or not prompt or type(prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute)) ~= "number" then continue end
		local binding = tracked[prompt]
		if not binding or not binding.enabledChanged or binding.carrier ~= carrier
			or binding.character ~= character or binding.root ~= root then
			local range = if binding then binding.range else prompt.MaxActivationDistance
			if range <= 0 then continue end
			if binding then disconnect(binding) end
			local nextBinding: Peer = { carrier = carrier, character = character, root = root, prompt = prompt,
				range = range, seen = sweep }
			tracked[prompt] = nextBinding
			local function changed()
				-- An event that was queued for an old body or binding cannot act on a replacement.
				if tracked[prompt] == nextBinding and nextBinding.enabledChanged then
					refreshPeer(nextBinding, getViewer())
				end
			end
			nextBinding.enabledChanged = prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(changed)
			nextBinding.readyChanged = prompt:GetAttributeChangedSignal(readyAttribute):Connect(changed)
			binding = nextBinding
		end
		binding.seen = sweep
		refreshPeer(binding, viewer)
	end
	for prompt, binding in pairs(tracked) do
		if binding.seen == sweep then continue end
		disconnect(binding)
		if prompt:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			-- A retired avatar can still be visible briefly. Retain its original
			-- radius for rebind while its exact prompt remains in the scene.
			present(binding, false)
		else

			-- releasing our reference, even if this object is later reinserted.
			if not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end
			if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= binding.range then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = binding.range end
			tracked[prompt] = nil
		end
	end
end

  local strike=smoothstep((u-.18)/(strikeEnd-.18))
  return -.20+1.20*strike,strike
 elseif u<holdEnd then
  return 1,1
 else
  local recover=1-smoothstep((u-holdEnd)/(1-holdEnd))
  return recover,recover
 end
end

task.spawn(function()
--!strict
-- Local presentation for the private Studio match. The server owns relay eligibility.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
if not RunService:IsStudio() then return end

local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local relayName = "EGGRUMBLE_ClassicEggRelay"
type CharacterWatch = {
	character: Model,
	added: RBXScriptConnection?,
	removing: RBXScriptConnection?,
	relays: { [ProximityPrompt]: RBXScriptConnection },
}
local current: CharacterWatch?

local function clearCharacter()
	local old = current
	if not old then return end
	current = nil
	if old.added then old.added:Disconnect() end
	if old.removing then old.removing:Disconnect() end
	for _, connection in pairs(old.relays) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
end

local function watchCharacter(character: Model)
	if player.Character ~= character or (current and current.character == character) then return end
	clearCharacter()
	local watch: CharacterWatch = {character = character, added = nil, removing = nil, relays = {}}
	current = watch

	local function consider(instance: Instance)
		if not instance:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or instance.Name ~= relayName then return end
		local root = instance.Parent
		if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart")
			or root.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" or root.Parent ~= character then return end
		if watch.relays[instance] then return end

		local function hideOwnRelay()
			if current == watch and player.Character == character
				and instance.Parent == root and root.Parent == character and instance.Enabled then
				instance.Enabled = false
			end
		end
		watch.relays[instance] = instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(hideOwnRelay)
		hideOwnRelay()
	end

	watch.added = character.DescendantAdded:Connect(consider)
	watch.removing = character.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(instance)
		if not instance:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return end
		local connection = watch.relays[instance]
		if not connection then return end
		watch.relays[instance] = nil
		connection:Disconnect()
	end)
	for _, instance in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		consider(instance)
	end
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(watchCharacter)
player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
	if current and current.character == character then
		clearCharacter()
	end
end)
if player.Character then
	watchCharacter(player.Character)
end

local teamAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationTeam"

local receiverReadyAttribute = "EGGRUMBLE_RelayPresentationReceiverReady"
local rayLift = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.RespectCanCollide = true

type Viewer = { character: Model, root: BasePart, round: number, team: string }
type Peer = {
	carrier: Player,
	character: Model,
	root: BasePart,
	prompt: ProximityPrompt,
	range: number,
	enabledChanged: RBXScriptConnection?,
	readyChanged: RBXScriptConnection?,
	seen: number,
}
local tracked: { [ProximityPrompt]: Peer } = {}

local function findRelay(character: Model?): (BasePart?, ProximityPrompt?)
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return nil, nil end
	local prompt = root:FindFirstChild(relayName)
	if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return root, nil end
	return root, prompt
end

local function liveTeamPlayer(actor: Player, character: Model): boolean
	if not character.Parent or actor:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_QueuedMode") ~= "TEAM"
		or actor:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Eliminated") == true then return false end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function getViewer(): Viewer?
	local character = player.Character
	if not character or not liveTeamPlayer(player, character) then return nil end
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_LOBBY_CASTLE_MODES_PREVIEW")
	local arena = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("TEAM_Arena")
	if not arena or arena:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase") ~= "ACTIVE" then return nil end
	local root, prompt = findRelay(character)
	if not root or not prompt or prompt:GetAttribute(receiverReadyAttribute) ~= true then return nil end
	local round = prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute)
	local team = prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute)
	if type(round) ~= "number" or (team ~= "RED" and team ~= "BLUE") then return nil end
	return { character = character, root = root, round = round, team = team }
end

local function present(binding: Peer, visible: boolean)
	local prompt = binding.prompt
	if visible and prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false end
	local distance = if visible then binding.range else 0
	if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= distance then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = distance end
	if not visible and not prompt.RequiresLineOfSight then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true end
end

local function refreshPeer(binding: Peer, viewer: Viewer?)
	local carrier, character, root, prompt = binding.carrier, binding.character, binding.root, binding.prompt
	if prompt.Parent ~= root or root.Parent ~= character then
		present(binding, false)
		return
	end
	local height = prompt:GetAttribute(heightAttribute)
	local visible = false
	if viewer and carrier.Parent == peers and carrier.Character == character and liveTeamPlayer(carrier, character)
		and prompt.Enabled and prompt:GetAttribute(readyAttribute) == true
		and prompt:GetAttribute(roundAttribute) == viewer.round and prompt:GetAttribute(teamAttribute) == viewer.team
		and type(height) == "number" then
		local delta = root.Position - viewer.root.Position
		if math.abs(delta.Y) <= height and delta.Magnitude <= binding.range then
			rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { viewer.character, character }
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(viewer.root.Position + rayLift, delta, rayParams)
			visible = hit == nil or not hit.Instance.CanCollide
		end
	end
	present(binding, visible)
end

local function disconnect(binding: Peer)
	if binding.enabledChanged then binding.enabledChanged:Disconnect(); binding.enabledChanged = nil end
	if binding.readyChanged then binding.readyChanged:Disconnect(); binding.readyChanged = nil end
end

				end

			nextBinding.enabledChanged = prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(changed)
